limitations_and_construct_boundary: 证据来源为网页文章，claim为文本；不含图像输入、像素篡改、视觉定位或法证标注。可用于解释接地和证据溯源的跨域设计背景，但不可推断视觉鉴伪解释可信或已得到用户验证。
screening_conclusion: 由T222参考文献[23]发现并全文核读。保留为方法学邻接，明确区分“展示可追溯证据片段”与“验证解释正确/忠实/有用”。未新增Scholar结果。

paper: Focused LRP: Explainable AI for Face Morphing Attack Detection
verified_identity: Clemens Seibold, Anna Hilsmann, and Peter Eisert; WACV Workshops 2021, pp. 88–96; DOI 10.1109/WACVW52041.2021.00014; arXiv:2103.14697v1. Same author/research line as Feature Focus (Computers 10(9):117, 2021; DOI 10.3390/computers10090117); linked publications must not be counted as independent study replications.
relevance_class: 直接相关：面部morph鉴伪解释的输入干预代理评测；与Feature Focus期刊版属于同一作者研究线/重叠研究项目，不作为独立复制研究计数。
scope_and_methods: 核读CVF官方9页WACV Workshops论文的任务、FLRP设计、数据划分、干预评测、结果及结论。以约2,000张真实脸和同量级morph图训练VGG-A检测器，按subject隔离划分train/test/validation（70/20/10；EER 3.3%）。对每个morph图按解释图排名选取前α比例像素，以对齐的真实源脸像素替换；对mask做3×3膨胀、5×5模糊以减少边界伪影，再随α变化测模型预测/损失/APCER变化，并比较FLRP、LRP与Sensitivity Maps。
observed_reliability_evidence: 论文报告该代理的排序结果并不等于定位精度：Sensitivity Maps在决策/损失变化量上整体高于FLRP与LRP；FLRP在检测不确定或出错样例中比其他方法更能突出可见morph伪影。作者报告测试morph中约6.1%对检测器不确定（morph softmax <0.9），这些样例上的FLRP-LRP归一化图差平均约0.92（SD 0.13）。因此本研究提供的是输入替换下的模型决策敏感性证据与伪影定位比较，两种终点应分开理解。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 作者明确表示没有真实解释ground truth可规定应该替换哪些区域或多少比例；以对齐原脸替换是其代理，不构成解释区域的因果必要/充分性真值，也不证明热图对应独立标注的全部真实伪造证据。替换同时改变内容与局部图像分布，结果会受替换源、平滑和α设置影响。无独立人类解释质量/评分者一致性、跨随机种子稳定性或用户appropriate-reliance实验。与Feature Focus期刊版按同一研究线管理，不将会议版和扩展工作作为两次独立验证。
screening_conclusion: 作为本选题的直接早期方法和输入干预代理证据纳入优先表；完整核读会议版本并对其参考文献30/30逐项做题名/主题初筛。Reference [25]引出独立的Seibold et al. 2020 JISA论文（T226）。Feature Focus期刊版已在172中核读，会议论文此次作为单独出版载体补入；综合证据时按一个研究线、多个出版报告处理。未新增Google Scholar命中。

paper: Accurate and robust neural networks for face morphing attack detection
verified_identity: Clemens Seibold, Wojciech Samek, Anna Hilsmann, and Peter Eisert; Journal of Information Security and Applications 53 (2020), article 102526; DOI 10.1016/j.jisa.2020.102526. The linked Fraunhofer record points to author preprint arXiv:1806.04265v1, titled Accurate and Robust Neural Networks for Security Related Applications Exampled by Face Morphing Attacks; the title-different preprint is treated as the same work, not a second paper.
relevance_class: 面部morph鉴伪和LRP诊断的前序机制论文；与解释评测直接相邻，但未形成专门的解释可靠性验证研究。
scope_and_methods: 从Focused LRP参考文献[25]沿引文链核读Fraunhofer链接的arXiv作者稿（16页，2018年v1；正式期刊身份以Fraunhofer/ScienceDirect DOI记录为准；本轮未逐页比对2020期刊排版版）。论文使用约1,900张原始人脸及生成的morph图，训练VGG19，并用四种数据构造/训练策略改变可用伪造区域；以partial morph区域测试语义鲁棒性，以FGSM加替代模型测试黑盒攻击；使用LRP考察预测相关性分布是否落在morph区域。
observed_reliability_evidence: 论文把partial-morph已知区域作为检测弱点测试；朴素训练模型对四类单区域morph的平均检测率为20%，multiclass训练为87%。LRP分布与部分检测失败相呼应：朴素模型对nose/mouth伪造的relevance较多落在非伪造区域，且这些区域的检测率较弱。作者同时指出multiclass情况下看似落在真实区域的正相关性可能来自模型比较结构，甚至“缺少relevance”也可能表达该区域作用；因此单看热图空间重叠容易产生错误解释。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 论文以LRP作为模型诊断和训练分析工具，不是对LRP解释器效度的独立实验：没有解释与独立取证事实标注的系统匹配、faithfulness/删除插入/反事实指标、参数随机化或解释稳定性测试，也没有人类评估或appropriate-reliance终点。partial-morph区域用于检测器鲁棒性，不等于解释充分性/必要性的因果真值。证据来自特定人脸morph攻击任务，不能泛化到拼接、卫星图像或生成图鉴伪。正式期刊PDF与2018预印本的逐项差异尚未核对。
screening_conclusion: 由T225参考文献[25]发现；纳入候选与低于两篇2021直接解释评测工作的优先级，作为独立前序方法论文/诊断边界证据。完整读到公开arXiv作者稿并核实期刊DOI、机构库记录和题名别名；明确标记未比较最终期刊PDF。本篇结果不是新的Google Scholar命中。

paper: You Only Explain Once
verified_identity: David A. Kelly, Hana Chockler, Daniel Kroening, Nathan Blake, Aditi Ramaswamy, Melane Navaratnarajah, and Aaditya Shivakumar; arXiv:2311.14081v1 (2023), DOI 10.48550/arXiv.2311.14081.
relevance_class: Method-adjacent: causal sufficient-pixel explanations for image object detectors; not image-forgery detection.
scope_and_methods: Full arXiv HTML read (abstract, method, experiments, conclusion, references). ANON-ReX adapts ReX/causal responsibility to multiple object detections, returning a pixel subset inside each detector box that preserves the original label under masking. Evaluates YOLOv8n, SSD, and Faster R-CNN on ImageNet-mini; excludes 210/3923 images with no YOLO detections. Compares query count and explanation size with a ReX baseline and analyzes two YOLO misclassifications.
observed_reliability_evidence: The explanation definition imposes model-internal sufficiency under a specified masking intervention and can expose plausible shortcut cues in two misclassification examples. Against the baseline, ANON-ReX uses fewer queries but produces explanations 20.7% larger for YOLO, 22.4% larger for SSD, and 52.9% larger for Faster R-CNN. The paper notes explanations may not be smallest and can inherit bounding-box geometry.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: No image-forgery/authenticity task, no independent ground-truth causal evidence map, and no explanation robustness, randomization, human agreement, or user reliance test. Preserving a label under masking is model-internal sufficiency, not proof that highlighted pixels are the authentic forensic evidence. The accuracy/meaning of masking and causal-independence assumptions remain intervention-dependent.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a lower-ranked image-explanation method neighbor for causal sufficiency and forensic-localization benchmark design; do not count it as direct forensic reliability evidence.

paper: Multiple Different Black Box Explanations for Image Classifiers
verified_identity: Hana Chockler, David A. Kelly, and Daniel Kroening; arXiv:2309.14309v4 (2025) and ECAI 2025 proceedings, first published online 2026-08-25, DOI 10.3233/FAIA250869. The 2023 arXiv title/version and formal proceedings record share authors and core method; treated as one research work pending line-by-line version comparison.
relevance_class: Method-adjacent: causal sufficiency, multiple explanations, and explanation-induced error discovery for image classifiers; not forensic detection.
scope_and_methods: Read the full arXiv HTML and official ECAI proceedings page. MultiReX uses approximate causal-responsibility ranking and a stochastic spatial search to find multiple minimal pixel subsets that alone retain the top class; compares explanation count, label position, and area against SAG on ImageNet-mini, VOC2012, and ECSSD using ResNet50, ConvNeXt-Large, and ViT-B/32. Includes a tennis-racket/shorts shortcut example and a preliminary occlusion example.
observed_reliability_evidence: MultiReX constrains explanations to the model's top class and reports smaller average explanations (~8% of image area vs ~14% for SAG at threshold 0.9); it exposes a region of a player's shorts that supports a tennis-racket label. SAG's explanations can fall far below the top class as its threshold changes. These are useful internal-consistency and shortcut-diagnostic results.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: No forensic/authenticity task or independent ground-truth causal evidence. Explanation count, area, and top-label preservation are not factual correctness or causal-faithfulness ground truth. The paper reports no user study of MultiReX, expert agreement, explanation randomization/robustness, or appropriate-reliance experiment. The authors acknowledge spatial search can miss non-contiguous explanations and did not comprehensively test occluded images. Comparison to SAG is not perfectly matched because the explanation definitions differ.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a high-value image-XAI method neighbor for explanation ambiguity and sufficiency controls, but do not count as direct forensic reliability evidence. Formal and arXiv versions are one work, not independent replication.

paper: Explanations for Occluded Images
verified_identity: Hana Chockler, Daniel Kroening, and Youcheng Sun; IEEE/CVF ICCV 2021, pp. 1234–1243, DOI 10.1109/ICCV48922.2021.00127; arXiv:2103.03622.
relevance_class: Method-adjacent: causal sufficiency and evidence-grounding measures for explanations under occlusion; not image-forgery detection.
scope_and_methods: Full paper and official ICCV/arXiv records reviewed. DC-Causal uses causal responsibility to rank pixels and greedily construct a minimal subset that preserves the classifier label under masking. Evaluations include known-occlusion image sets, a Photo Bombing dataset with planted occlusion ground truth, and a non-occluded Roaming Panda set; comparison measures explanation size, overlap with planted occlusion, and IoU with the panda region. On COCO images without explanation ground truth, normalized size is only a proxy.
observed_reliability_evidence: On Photo Bombing, over 60% of DC-Causal explanations have no overlap with the planted occluder, which the paper reports as about 20% better than the next method (RISE); it also produces smaller explanations, but the size and occlusion-overlap rankings do not always agree. On Roaming Panda, overlap with the known panda region provides a separate localization check. The paper reports that varying mask color changes occlusion-overlap performance by less than 4% in its tested setup.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: This is not a forensic authenticity task. A planted occluder or panda mask is a useful localization reference, but it does not define the causal evidence needed to decide image authenticity. COCO evaluation lacks an explanation truth map and substitutes explanation size. The greedy explanation is an approximation; masking color and intervention distribution remain consequential, and stability across model/data shifts or human forensic judgments is not established.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a high-value image-domain method neighbor for evidence-overlap, sufficiency, and multi-metric evaluation design. Do not count it as direct forensic explanation-reliability evidence.

paper: One Explanation is Not Enough: Structured Attention Graphs for Image Classification
verified_identity: Vivswan Shitole, Fuxin Li, Minsuk Kahng, Prasad Tadepalli, and Alan Fern; NeurIPS 2021, Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 34, pp. 11352–11363; arXiv:2011.06733.
relevance_class: Method-adjacent: image explanation multiplicity and a human counterfactual-understanding study; not forensic authenticity or evidence-correctness research.
scope_and_methods: Full 12-page NeurIPS paper reviewed. Structured Attention Graphs encode multiple minimal sufficient image regions and confidence changes under patch deletion. The main between-subject study recruited 60 university engineering students; each answered 10 comparative questions about which occluded ImageNet subimage would preserve the original class score, with/without SAG, Grad-CAM, or I-GOS. A separate 40-person ablation compared graph and interaction components.
observed_reliability_evidence: In the main study, SAG users averaged 8.6/10 correct (SD 1.698), versus 5.4 (SD 1.188) for I-GOS and 5.3 (SD 1.031) for Grad-CAM; both comparisons were reported p<.0001. SAG users' confidence was better aligned with answer correctness, which is a human model-behavior prediction/calibration signal. The ablation suggests both graph structure and interactive highlighting contributed to task performance.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The study asks users to predict the classifier's response to synthetic occlusions, not to judge whether an explanation identifies actual forensic evidence or whether an authenticity verdict is correct. It uses ImageNet image classification and a small set of 10 image/question contexts, with university engineering students; confidence alignment is not real-world appropriate reliance. No forensic ground truth, expert forensic raters, explanation-randomization test, or detector explanation faithfulness evaluation is reported.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a useful human-task and explanation-multiplicity neighbor. It supports evaluating whether explanations help users predict model behavior, but cannot establish forensic evidence truth, decision validity, or appropriate reliance in image-authenticity work.

paper: Fake News Detection and Manipulation Reasoning via Large Vision-Language Models
verified_identity: Ruihan Jin, Ruibo Fu, Zhengqi Wen, Shuai Zhang, Yukun Liu, and Jianhua Tao; arXiv:2407.02042v1 (2024). Full paper HTML bears MM'24 manuscript formatting but contains placeholder DOI/ISBN and malformed citation-year text; final ACM publication metadata not verified.
relevance_class: Strong method/human-evaluation neighbor: multimodal media-manipulation reasoning with some face-image edits and region boxes; not a direct image-only forensic explanation-fidelity study.
scope_and_methods: Full official arXiv HTML reviewed, including HFFN construction, manipulation types, model, experiments, human-rating protocol, conclusion, and references. HFFN has 655 image-text news items across four domains and includes face-swap/facial-attribute edits, text manipulation, factual errors, and cross-modal combinations; manipulated image regions receive bounding boxes. Ten professional annotators prepare reasoning annotations; each item is independently annotated by two and one annotation is selected. M-DRUM combines ImageBind, a face encoder, cross-modal fusion, and an LVLM. Separately, 12 independent human raters assess randomly chosen generated reasoning outputs on 1–10 Exactness, Certainty, and Detail scales.
observed_reliability_evidence: The study operationalizes Exactness as correctness and consistency with the news content and provides a human-rated signal for manipulation-reasoning quality. Table 2 reports M-DRUM scores 9.10 Exactness, 8.45 Certainty, and 7.25 Detail, compared with human-annotation GT scores 9.30, 8.97, and 8.48. The benchmark also contains manually annotated clues and manipulated-region boxes, and training includes box losses; these support supervision but are not themselves an independent explanation-fidelity evaluation.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The task combines image, text, factual manipulation, and news context, so ratings do not isolate visual forensic reasoning. The paper does not report the number of rated outputs, evaluator expertise, blinding/assignment procedure, inter-rater agreement, or uncertainty intervals. Human Exactness is a subjective rating against news content; the paper does not independently audit every claim or explanation against external ground truth. Bounding boxes supervise a region prediction head but the rating protocol does not measure whether a verbal explanation is causally faithful to image evidence. No parameter-randomization sanity check, deletion/insertion faithfulness test, explanation robustness analysis, or appropriate-reliance study is reported. The arXiv HTML has malformed ACM metadata placeholders; final publisher record not verified.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a strong adjacent precedent for human evaluation of evidence-grounded multimodal media-manipulation reasoning. Do not count as direct image-only forensic explanation-reliability evidence or interpret its high mean ratings as validated causal faithfulness or appropriate reliance.

paper: Universal Anti-forensics Attack against Image Forgery Detection via Multi-modal Guidance
verified_identity: Haipeng Li, Rongxuan Peng, Anwei Luo, Shunquan Tan, Changsheng Chen, Anastasia Antsiferova; arXiv:2602.06530v2, 2026-02-19.
relevance_class: 直接核心威胁证据：对抗操纵使图像取证解释为伪造图编造真实理由
scope_and_methods: 本页复用已核官方arXiv v2全文：Forg­eryEraser以CLIP视觉/文本语义锚点优化小幅图像扰动，攻击6个AIGC检测器，覆盖全生成和局部编辑；解释影响在SIDA与FakeVLM展示，附录扩展到卫星、文档、局部编辑等例子。检测攻击量化覆盖准确率下降、跨模型与压缩/模糊鲁棒性。
observed_reliability_evidence: 直接反例：SIDA对伪造钟表原先识别“physically incorrect reflections”，攻击后转为“physically accurate light interactions”；FakeVLM对deepfake原先指出“lifeless eyes”，攻击后转为“natural moisture gradients”。说明语义级扰动可同时翻转判决并制造可信外观的错误解释。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 解释层结果以精选定性图示报告，没有随机样本解释错误率、独立专家/人类事实性评分、评分者一致性、faithfulness曲线或用户依赖测量。检测准确率攻击成功不能当作解释错误率。预印本，代码未复核。
screening_conclusion: 强相关核心威胁研究，直接纳入对抗解释鲁棒性证据；明确为定性脆弱性示例，不推断解释总体错误率或正常输入faithfulness。

paper: Memory-Anchored Multimodal Reasoning for Explainable Video Forensics
verified_identity: Chen Chen, Runze Li, Zejun Zhang, Pukun Zhao, Fanqing Zhou, Longxiang Wang, Haojian Huang; arXiv:2508.14581v2; submitted 2025-08-20, revised 2025-09-10; preprint.
relevance_class: 强相关视频/多模态媒体取证邻接：自然语言理由、区域/实体/时间接地与解释数据集；非静态图像直接实证。
scope_and_methods: 官方v2全文定向核读：摘要、引言、X-AVFake数据集与标注、FakeHunter的观察—思考—行动推理、记忆检索与工具核验、实验设置、比较、消融和结论。输入为音视频；模型输出真假、操作类型和自然语言解释；X-AVFake注释操作目标/时间锚点、推理类别及解释。
observed_reliability_evidence: 文章将X-AVFake描述为用于考验上下文接地与解释保真的基准，并以操作目标、时间/区域和解释标签支持解释研究。模型实验报告检测准确率、不同模态子集和组件消融。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 作者对explanation fidelity的表述主要是数据集/设计目标；已核实验结果未见独立解释faithfulness指标、理由事实错误率、人类评分及一致性、参数随机化或解释专属删除/插入测试。准确率和组件消融不证明理由忠实。音视频深伪任务与静态图像存在媒介差异；数据生成依赖模型规划和编辑管线，标注质量/独立性需另审。
screening_conclusion: 纳入视频取证解释接地邻接；作为新方法/数据集线索，不作为已验证faithfulness基准或图像单模态核心实证。

paper: Memory-augmented vision transformers with class activation mapping for authenticity and clarity evaluation in digital art
verified_identity: Jiexiao Tang and Qun Pang; Discover Artificial Intelligence 6, Article 743 (2026); published 2026-05-30; DOI 10.1007/s44163-026-01479-7; Springer Nature open access.
relevance_class: 合成图/数字艺术真实性解释评价邻接：AI生成与人工作品二分类，Grad-CAM/LIME可视解释及作者报告的多项解释指标；不是传统图像篡改/局部伪造直接研究。
scope_and_methods: 核读官方全文题录/摘要、§§2–4任务与方法、§5结果讨论及限制。模型在一个60,000图像Kaggle集合上区分AI生成与人工作品，展示Grad-CAM/LIME；正文称Table 5比较Grad-CAM deletion/insertion、pointing game、localization error与consistency。
observed_reliability_evidence: 作者报告高亮区域删除会降低模型表现，插入高亮区域会提高预测置信度；并报告pointing game、localization error及多次运行一致性指标。该研究因此直接属于合成图真实性解释评估邻接，而非只有可视化展示。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 全文未充分说明deletion/insertion曲线的具体基线与扰动定义，亦未交代支持pointing-game/localization-error的独立伪迹区域真值及标注流程；没有参数随机化sanity check、人类解释评分/一致性或appropriate reliance评估。单一Kaggle数据集测试，作者明确提出外部/跨域验证是未来工作。对AI艺术与人工作品二分类的结论不可直接外推到局部图像篡改定位或通用鉴伪。
screening_conclusion: 纳入合成图真实性解释可靠性邻接，并保留“作者提出/报告”的效度边界；删除/插入分数作为模型依赖代理，不视为外部因果解释真值。此前74中四个相关位置由先前题录级疑点改判为邻接纳入。

paper: Are We Merely Justifying Results ex Post Facto? Quantifying Explanatory Inversion in Post-Hoc Model Explanations
verified_identity: Zhen Tan et al.; arXiv:2504.08919v1 (2025-04-11), preprint
relevance_class: 强方法学邻接：图像后验解释的faithfulness、GT对齐与spurious-feature稳健性；非取证应用
scope_and_methods: 核读官方HTML题录/摘要、§§1–7、图像实验附录与结论。提出Inversion Quantification (IQ)，以output reliance R、perturbation-based faithfulness F、Inversion Score IS及有GT时的alignment A评价解释；合成形状CNN任务包含spurious distractor pixel，并与ground-truth bounding boxes对齐；另展示CIFAR/ResNet-18狗图上的像素干扰case study。比较LIME、SHAP、IG、Occlusion、Shapley Value Sampling，并提出Reproduce-by-Poking (RBP)。
observed_reliability_evidence: 报告spurious输出相关像素会使解释移向无关区域并降低GT alignment；RBP在图像合成任务上降低ΔIS约2.19%。该方向直接支撑解释可靠性检验方法，而不是仅将检测准确率当作解释效度。

paper: VizAnchor: Decoding Manipulation Intent from Tampering Visualizations via Dual-Anchor Reasoning
verified_identity: Xiaotian Zhang, Huayuan Ye, Haiyang Zhang, Chenhui Li, Changbo Wang, Sicheng Song; arXiv:2608.24535v1 [cs.CV], 2026-08-25.

paper: GReX-Bench: Benchmarking Generalization, Robustness, and Explainability in AI-Generated Image Detection
verified_identity: Nusrat Tasnim, Kutub Uddin, Khalid Malik. ResearchSquare v1, posted 2026-02-12; DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-8633550/v1. SSRN abstract_id=6032054 is a similar same-author Scholar record; relation to this version remains unconfirmed.
relevance_class: High topical relevance as an AI-generated-image detection explainability benchmark/method neighbor; not direct evidence that explanations are reliable or faithful.
scope_and_methods: Read the 55-page official ResearchSquare v1 PDF. The abstract describes 16 detectors, 8 datasets and 6 anti-forensic attacks, and uses saliency/Grad-CAM, SHAP, Sobol sensitivity analysis and LLM-written reports. The paper visualizes detector/model behavior and evaluates detector generalization/robustness. Selected references [48–52,80] screened individually; the other 137 reference entries were not screened.
observed_reliability_evidence: The manuscript presents saliency/Grad-CAM maps and feature-sensitivity plots and gives examples of LLM reports. It does not report independent explanation ground truth, human correctness ratings, inter-rater agreement, parameter-randomization/sanity checks, deletion/insertion explanation-faithfulness tests, explanation stability under anti-forensic attacks, or a user appropriate-reliance study. Sobol indices describe model-output sensitivity/feature interactions, not whether an explanation is factually or causally faithful. Detector performance under anti-forensic attacks is not an explanation robustness test.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Do not conflate visualization, model-feature sensitivity, detector robustness, and explanation validity. The PDF has an internal reporting inconsistency: abstract states 16 detectors/8 datasets while the conclusion states 8 methods/7 datasets; p.9 also contains a stray editor-facing sentence. The ResearchSquare DOI landing page and SSRN record page returned 403; only the official static RS PDF was readable. No explicit statement confirmed that SSRN abstract_id=6032054 is this manuscript's earlier title/version. Only six selected citations ([48–52,80]) were screened; full 143-item bibliography review remains open.
screening_conclusion: Retain in the task-related methods/benchmark neighbor group and use it to document a clear evaluation gap. Do not count it as a positive explanation-faithfulness study or as a completed reliability validation. Prioritize later version/metadata resolution if a legitimate record becomes accessible.

observed_reliability_evidence: 未见把解释可靠性作为量化终点的实证。Occlusion图是个案可视化，作者称其衡量区域对输出的因果影响，但没有用已知区域级伪造真值、扰动基线对照或独立忠实度指标校准该解释。ACC/AUC与阈值校准评估的是检测器，不验证解释是否正确。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 全文未报告解释真值/标注区域对照、parameter-randomization sanity check、deletion/insertion faithfulness曲线或分数、解释对输入变换/模型随机种子的稳定性、解释正确性/完整性人评、用户信任校准或appropriate-reliance测量。Grad-CAM层级热图和occlusion个案用于定性诊断；检测泛化提升不能推出解释可靠性提升。范围仅StyleGAN/StyleGAN2/SDv1.4合成脸，不是一般图像编辑/拼接鉴伪。
screening_conclusion: 保留为强任务邻接、非正向解释效度证据。全文核读已完成；ACM Cloudflare验证由用户手动恢复后取得官方PDF。其32条参考文献将逐条登记并与已有身份交叉核对。 ACM官方PDF的References [1]–[32]已逐条做题录/主题筛查并与已有账本交叉匹配；逐条理由见T317 sidecar。方法基础Grad-CAM与Occlusion相关的通用论文已标出，但无一篇从本参考文献表新增为图像取证解释效度实证研究。

paper: AI-generated Images Challenge Visual Trust in High-risk Scenarios
verified_identity: Yi-Zhi Wang, Yichen Xiao, Linan Yue, Weibo Gao, Yichao Du, Pengfei Fang, Shimin Di, Min-Ling Zhang; arXiv:2607.22745v1, submitted 2026-07-23.
relevance_class: 直接核心：AI生成图检测解释与人类证据区域/自然语言标注的grounding和覆盖率核查
scope_and_methods: 全文§2.5/§3.5核读。SafeIMG含12个公共/个人安全场景；人工对可识别异常图标出可疑区域框、异常类别并给简短文字说明，含文字/人脸/手部等局部伪迹和常识、场景逻辑、物理约束异常。解释对齐实验以Claude Opus 4.6生成理由、GPT-5.5作语义judge，评价理由是否击中人工标注异常。
observed_reliability_evidence: 全文报告Human-Covered-by-AI平均29.8%；类别I1个人事故19.1%、I2交易收据21.4%；人工Commonsense异常覆盖15.01%，Physics异常12.00%。另报告AI-Supported-by-Human总体14.3%，提示不被人工标注支持的模型理由不能直接等同幻觉。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 该研究是解释理由对人工异常标注的覆盖/语义对齐证据，不是模型归因图对预测因果影响的faithfulness test，也未测参数随机化、删除插入或解释对输入扰动的因果稳定性。对齐由单一模型生成理由并由GPT-5.5语义judge评分；目前原文报告的是模型/标注对齐，不是终端用户依赖或信任校准。域为高风险场景AI生成图而非传统拼接/修补照片。
screening_conclusion: 强相关核心：可作为图像鉴伪解释grounding/completeness的直接证据，尤其说明理由遗漏高层场景异常；与因果faithfulness、事实正确性全量审核和appropriate reliance保持构念区分。

paper: Seam Carving Forgery Detection Through Multi-Perspective Explainable AI
verified_identity: P. R. Galego Hernandes et al.; Journal of Imaging 2025, 11(11), 416; DOI 10.3390/jimaging11110416.
relevance_class: 强任务邻接：传统seam-carving数字图像伪造检测中的XAI应用；解释效度未证
scope_and_methods: 公开全文核读。针对seam-carving篡改构建10,300图像平衡二分类集，训练CNN检测器；e-XAI将SHAP像素归因和Grad-CAM区域热图组合，展示若干代表图。报告检测测试准确率95%、伪造类precision 99%，另测试JPEG压缩鲁棒性。
observed_reliability_evidence: 论文对解释图做一项行为相关性分析：Grad-CAM强度与局部Laplacian纹理复杂度的Pearson相关r=0.3220，p<0.001。该分析显示热图偏向高纹理复杂区域，但不能证明该区域就是算法篡改处或真实决策因果依据。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 未见用已知seam-carving mask/像素真值评价解释定位，未见parameter-randomization sanity check、deletion/insertion faithfulness曲线、解释扰动稳定性、人类解释正确性评价或appropriate-reliance研究。作者关于“更可靠理解/透明”的表述不能由分类性能或纹理相关性单独支持。
screening_conclusion: 保留为直接任务邻接和XAI应用实例；不是解释可靠性的正向实证证据。

paper: ASAP: Interpretable Analysis and Summarization of AI-generated Image Patterns at Scale
verified_identity: J. Huang, C. Chen, A. Mishra, B. C. Kwon, Z. Liu, C. Bryan; arXiv:2404.02990 (2024).
relevance_class: Direct AIGI pixel-attribution/visual-analysis task; independent explanation-reliability tests not reported
scope_and_methods: Official arXiv full text reviewed. Uses CLIP ViT-B/32 features, 16 distilled dimensions, backpropagated attention relevance and classifier weights to quantify pixel evidence; includes latent what-if visual exploration.
observed_reliability_evidence: No ground-truth explanation alignment, deletion/insertion curve, parameter-randomization sanity check, adversarial explanation stability, human explanation-correctness evaluation or appropriate-reliance study was found. The explanation method directly targets AIGI but its validity is not independently tested.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Pixel relevance and latent what-if do not alone establish faithfulness to the model's actual decision process. Detection performance and visual examples are not explanation-validity evidence.
screening_conclusion: Added full-text review; retain as a directly task-relevant AIGI explanation method with no independent reliability endpoint found, not as positive faithfulness evidence.

paper: A Deep Learning and Hybrid Optimization Framework for Digital Evidence Tamper Detection: Legal Reliability, Chain of Custody, and Cyber Forensics
verified_identity: S. N. V. J. D. Kosuru, B. Unhelkar, S. Siva Shankar; Restitution Law Review 34(2), 2026; DOI 10.65677/rlr.v34i2.275.
relevance_class: Weak forensic-XAI task neighbor; not an explanation-reliability experiment
scope_and_methods: Publisher landing page and official 15-page PDF reviewed. Digital-evidence tamper detection combines deep learning and hybrid optimization; `4.3 displays Grad-CAM/SHAP and discusses SHA-256 evidence integrity and chain of custody.
observed_reliability_evidence: No explanation-to-mask alignment, perturbation faithfulness, parameter randomization, explanation stability, expert explanation assessment or user-reliance experiment was found. The paper's reliability claim concerns detection and evidence preservation.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: XAI heatmap display is not explanation validation. Evidence-chain reliability and classifier performance are separate constructs from explanation reliability.
screening_conclusion: Full-text review confirms weak task adjacency only; exclude from direct positive explanation-reliability evidence and strong empirical core.

paper: An Explainable AI Framework for Identity Document Authentication in AML/KYC Verification
verified_identity: Eldeena Huey Yinn Lim, Tee Connie; Future Internet 18(9), 485 (2026), published 16 September 2026; DOI 10.3390/fi18090485.
relevance_class: Cross-domain document-image forgery XAI neighbor; not natural-image/face deepfake direct evidence
scope_and_methods: Official MDPI article page and targeted full-text sections §§2.4, 3.3, 4.4.1–4.4.3 read in Chrome. Identity-document authentication on selected MIDV-2020 subsets; OCR-driven semantic checks, 32 handcrafted forensic features and Random Forest. Uses TreeSHAP global feature importance, a single-document waterfall explanation, Laplacian heatmaps and heuristic suspicious-region paths.
observed_reliability_evidence: The authors show global and one local SHAP explanation and compare feature-rank prominence with Random-Forest Mean-Decrease-in-Impurity; this is presentation/feature-ranking concordance, not an explanation-faithfulness test against an independent evidence ground truth.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: No annotated explanation ground truth, deletion/insertion or input perturbation fidelity, parameter-randomization sanity check, explanation-map stability, independent expert correctness rating or human appropriate-reliance study found in the targeted sections. The framework concerns identity documents and AML/KYC, so it is a cross-domain boundary case.
screening_conclusion: Add as a cross-domain document-forensics XAI neighbor to candidate and full-text boundary tables; do not count as direct positive explanation-reliability evidence for natural images or deepfakes.

paper: Improved tampering localization in digital image forensics based on maximal entropy random walk
verified_identity: Paweł Korus and Jiwu Huang, Improved Tampering Localization in Digital Image Forensics based on Maximal Entropy Random Walk, IEEE Signal Processing Letters 23(1), 2016, pp. 5–9; DOI 10.1109/LSP.2015.2496362.
relevance_class: Historical direct-task neighbor: image-splicing localization using detector-response maps and visual saliency; not post-hoc XAI reliability evidence
scope_and_methods: Complete 5-page author-hosted version read. Applies maximal-entropy random-walk post-processing to sliding-window forensic detector response maps for synthetic JPEG-splicing localization. Compares graph-weight strategies, including a visual-saliency cue, against threshold and Markov-prior baselines.
observed_reliability_evidence: Reports ROC/F1 localization performance against tampered-region ground truth; finds MERW improves localization, while the saliency weight performs best at low false-positive rates but requires a second MERW for adequate results. The paper also notes that the saliency map may emphasize distinctive response-map regions outside the tampered area, depending on the forensic feature.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Its map is a forensic localization decision output and post-processing of detector evidence. The experiment evaluates task localization, not whether an explanation faithfully reflects the detector's causal evidence. No parameter randomization, deletion/insertion explanation test, explanation stability, or human correctness/reliance evaluation.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a historical saliency/localization antecedent and construct-boundary example. Include in the relatedness tail, not as direct positive evidence that explanations are reliable.

paper: FakeWorld 1.0: An Omni-modal Benchmark for Fake Media and Content
verified_identity: Yifeng Gao et al., FakeWorld 1.0: An Omni-modal Benchmark for Fake Media and Content, Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 306:33118–33137 (2026). Official PMLR record: https://proceedings.mlr.press/v306/gao26g.html; OpenReview forum: https://openreview.net/forum?id=UXbNXAJRCo.
relevance_class: Strong adjacent: multimodal forensic authenticity/content-veracity reasoning with per-instance rationales and explicit annotation/evaluation reliability discussion; not a classic image-localization XAI paper
scope_and_methods: PMLR official abstract confirms text/audio/image/video media authenticity plus factuality/cross-modal consistency, per-instance rationales, and OmniChecker evidence-backed diagnostic reports. Public OpenReview reviews/rebuttals and posted rubric were read after user completed browser verification. Authors state rationales use forensic-literature-derived templates, expert-vetted before model ensemble generation, followed by two-person expert refinement; they reported >1,200 of 3,153 annotations revised at rebuttal time and <1% clear hallucinations in that audited subset. For explanation scoring, they report ROUGE-L/cosine to reference rationales and an LLM rubric for accuracy/completeness and detailedness; on 200+ cues, 3 annotators produced average Pearson r=.8708/Spearman rho=.8857 inter-annotator agreement and human–LLM agreement Pearson r=.8505/Spearman rho=.8325.
observed_reliability_evidence: Public rebuttal provides unusually direct evidence about rationale-quality validation and annotation quality assurance, with human–LLM agreement and inter-rater agreement figures. The rubric emphasizes coverage/precision and cue-specific detail, including no evidence omissions/fabrication. Reviewers explicitly questioned whether the templates/annotations ensure faithful explanations and whether the evaluation rubric was sufficiently specified.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: These reported checks validate textual rationale quality against reference annotations and the LLM rubric; they do not establish causal faithfulness to the model's internal decision, deletion/insertion or parameter-randomization behavior, localized heatmap accuracy, or appropriate human reliance. Annotation auditing is author-reported and ongoing; the <1% rate applies only to the audited subset at rebuttal time. The PDF itself was not read in this session: OpenReview PDF endpoint remained blank after navigation and PMLR's linked raw GitHub PDF was blocked by Chrome client policy. Treat process details as official review/rebuttal evidence, not as verified final-paper prose.
screening_conclusion: Promote to high-priority related literature and keep as a strong, carefully bounded multimodal neighbor. It is one of the closest papers found for evidence-grounded explanation quality in synthetic-media forensics; it does not settle causal model explanation faithfulness. PDF/full-paper follow-up remains open.

paper: Wavelet-Packets for Deepfake Image Analysis and Detection
verified_identity: Moritz Wolter, Felix Blanke, Raoul Heese, Jochen Garcke et al., “Wavelet-packets for deepfake image analysis and detection,” Machine Learning 111, 4295–4327 (2022), DOI 10.1007/s10994-022-06225-5.
relevance_class: Historical strong neighbor: intrinsic frequency-domain interpretability and saliency visualization for synthetic-image detection; no explanation-validity evidence
scope_and_methods: Springer open-access full article read, including abstract, methods and §§5.2–5.3. The work compares localized multiscale wavelet-packet coefficients of real and generated images and trains small forensic classifiers. It calls coefficient comparisons interpretable; for the CNN it uses Simonyan saliency maps as an exemplary interpretation approach (Fig. 8 and Fig. 10).
observed_reliability_evidence: Shows qualitative frequency-packet differences and gradient-saliency visualizations; authors report classifiers rely on spectral edges/high-frequency packets. The paper also reports detector performance and five-run variability for selected classification experiments. These are model-performance/reproducibility observations, not validation that the saliency explanations are faithful.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: No parameter-randomization sanity check, deletion/insertion or causal faithfulness test, explanation stability analysis, human rating of explanation correctness, or appropriate-reliance test is reported in the reviewed text. The wavelet representation offers an intrinsically interpretable feature view, while the Simonyan map is a qualitative post-hoc illustration; neither is independently validated as an explanation.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a strong historical method neighbor (2022), showing image-focused explainability predates the recent multimodal-rationale papers. Do not count it as positive empirical evidence that explanations are reliable.

paper: AvatarShield: Visual Reinforcement Learning for Human-Centric Synthetic Video Detection
verified_identity: Zhipei Xu, Xuanyu Zhang, Qing Huang, Xing Zhou, Jian Zhang. AvatarShield: Visual Reinforcement Learning for Human-Centric Synthetic Video Detection. International Journal of Computer Vision 134, article 402 (2026), DOI 10.1007/s11263-026-02954-5. Public preprint: arXiv:2505.15173v3, submitted 2025-05-21, revised 2025-09-23.
relevance_class: Strong adjacent: multimodal natural-language reasoning for human-centric synthetic-video detection; final-version explanation-quality evaluation potentially central, but not independently verified due paywall/version mismatch
scope_and_methods: Read the complete publicly available arXiv v3 HTML, including methods, experiments, answer-analysis appendix, and examples. It uses GRPO with binary real/fake labels and a temporal compensation reward to produce reasoning-style outputs; a discrete vision encoder supplies semantic features and VQ-VAE residual branch emphasizes low-level artifacts. The arXiv version reports detection AUC on 15K FakeHumanVid videos and qualitative answer examples. Springer official metadata/abstract and Scholar indexed snippet for the later 2026 IJCV version were separately checked; Springer says full text is subscription-only.
observed_reliability_evidence: The accessible preprint claims interpretable reasoning, includes generated explanations and examples, and its reward uses ordered-vs-shuffled temporal inputs to encourage temporal evidence use. The 2026 journal-version Scholar snippet states that the paper quantifies explanation quality and tests grounding in observable visual evidence. However, those specific quantitative evaluation details do not appear in the accessible v3 full text inspected, so their metric, sample, annotations, inter-rater protocol, and result cannot yet be verified.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: There is a version mismatch between the 2025 arXiv v3 text and the 2026 journal-version indexed snippet. Do not treat the snippet as verified methods/results. The accessible preprint has no independent explanation-to-ground-truth evaluation, parameter-randomization sanity check, deletion/insertion faithfulness test, explanation-stability study, or human appropriate-reliance experiment. Detection AUC and reasoning output do not establish the explanation is causally faithful. Formal IJCV full-text review remains blocked by subscription access.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a high-priority direct neighbor and record the formal version as pending full-text access. Its explanation-quality evaluation could be highly relevant, but present evidence supports only a claim that such evaluation is mentioned in the Scholar index; classify the reliability protocol as unresolved until the journal version can be inspected.

paper: Data-independent operator: A training-free artifact representation extractor for generalizable deepfake detection
verified_identity: Chuangchuang Tan et al., Data-Independent Operator: A Training-Free Artifact Representation Extractor for Generalizable Deepfake Detection, arXiv:2403.06803 (2024).
relevance_class: Image deepfake-detection neighbor: intrinsic/source-general artifact representation and conceptual interpretability; no explanation-validity experiment
scope_and_methods: Complete official arXiv HTML read, including §§III–IV and IV-E3. Uses fixed handcrafted/pretrained/random filters to suppress image content and extract generalizable artifact features; evaluates detection across 33 generation models. The authors describe this representation as explanatory. The visualization section uses t-SNE plots of classifier features across 15 sources.
observed_reliability_evidence: Reports detection accuracy/generalization across source domains and a random-seed table for detection metrics. Visualization qualitatively shows feature-space source grouping. The results do not test whether a saliency explanation tracks causal model evidence.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The “explanation” is a conceptual account of what the fixed operators represent; t-SNE is a feature-distribution plot, not an attribution map. No parameter-randomization sanity, deletion/insertion or causal faithfulness test, explanation stability, or human explanation-correctness/reliance study. The Scholar snippet about frequency-level perturbation maps was not found in this paper’s text and appears to be index/snippet contamination.
screening_conclusion: Keep as an early image-specific intrinsic-representation neighbor. It supports a pre-2024 lineage of interpretable forensic cues, but not empirical validation of explanation reliability.

paper: Joint Learning of Deep Texture and High-Frequency Features for Computer-Generated Image Detection
verified_identity: Qiang Xu, Shan Jia, Xinghao Jiang, Tanfeng Sun, Zhe Wang, Hong Yan. arXiv:2209.03322v1 (2022).
relevance_class: Early image authenticity / computer-generated image detection neighbor: intrinsic mechanism visualization; no explanation-reliability experiment
scope_and_methods: Read full official arXiv HTML v1. The model combines semantic-segmentation-guided deep texture rendering, high-frequency components, and spatial/channel attention for CG-versus-natural-photo detection. Fig. 11 displays original/segmented/rendered images and their high-frequency components. §V-C ablates high-pass filtering, attention, and texture rendering; postprocessing robustness tables measure detector ACC/TPR/TNR.
observed_reliability_evidence: The authors state the Fig. 11 visualizations clarify the rendering mechanism and show how texture/frequency signals differ. The ablation indicates texture rendering contributes to detector performance; postprocessing tests report detection accuracy under compression/noise.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: These are mechanism illustrations and detector-level perturbation robustness, not explanation faithfulness. The paper does not compare explanations with independent evidence ground truth, run parameter-randomization sanity checks, quantify explanation stability, or test human explanation correctness/reliance. Hand-crafted features are described as theoretically interpretable, but this does not validate the learned network’s attention as an explanation.
screening_conclusion: Retain as an early (2022) image-authenticity detector using mechanism visualization, useful to the historical lineage and construct-boundary discussion. Do not count it as empirical evidence that forensic explanations are reliable.

paper: VizDefender: Unmasking Visualization Tampering through Proactive Localization and Intent Inference
verified_identity: Sicheng Song, Yanjie Zhang, Zixin Chen, Huamin Qu, Changbo Wang, Chenhui Li; arXiv:2512.18853v1, 2025-12-21; IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics 32(6), 4720–4730 (2026), DOI 10.1109/TVCG.2026.3694448.
relevance_class: 图表/可视化图像篡改中解释接地与质量评价的强邻接；非一般自然图像/视频鉴伪。
scope_and_methods: 官方arXiv v1 HTML全文核读。系统先在图表嵌入半脆弱水印位置图，再用水印损坏定位篡改区域；MLLM模块按图表组件—篡改方式规则生成篡改过程和意图解释。§6.4用严格集合匹配评价篡改方式分类（82% vs. direct-prompt baseline 28%），并把模型输出与形成性研究志愿者给出的过程/意图真值做文本嵌入余弦相似度（平均0.874 vs. 0.836；意图0.907 vs. 0.881）。§7进行匿名化、随机顺序的7点Likert用户研究：30名研究生/研究人员评价5个案例中解释输出的合理性；另有掩码准确性评价。
observed_reliability_evidence: 存在多层证据：篡改定位在人工真值mask上报告IoU 0.7272/F1 0.8259；篡改方式按严格集合一致计分；过程/意图文本对志愿者提供的ground truth计算语义相似度；30人盲评输出合理性。论文提出规则约束用于减少MLLM不受证据约束的类别推断。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 半脆弱水印需在篡改前嵌入，研究对象限于图表可视化，不覆盖现成的普通照片、自然流通媒体或AI整图生成。文本嵌入余弦相似度不保证关键事实全对；形成性研究提供的真值和人评“合理性”没有显示独立逐条法证事实校准或标注者一致性。30人×5案例是小规模用户研究。未见显著图faithfulness的参数随机化、删除/插入、解释攻击稳定性或适当依赖评测。
screening_conclusion: 纳入图表篡改解释评价的强方法学邻接：它结合mask真值、规则约束、解释语义参照和用户合理性评价；须将“解释质量/合理性”与解释事实正确性、因果faithfulness及用户适当依赖分开。

paper: ExplainCrash: An Interactive Multi-method Explainable AI System for Dashcam Crash Detection
verified_identity: Ul Islam et al.; SSRN 7050339; DOI 10.2139/ssrn.7050339; posted 2026-07-22
relevance_class: 视觉视频XAI方法邻接；非图像/媒体鉴伪
scope_and_methods: 摘要描述dashcam事故视频检测系统，使用视觉帧流与对象统计流，提供十种解释工具；报告两种帧删除协议、时间注意力、对象分支与反事实解释分析。证据级别为官方索引摘要，未读全文。
observed_reliability_evidence: 摘要报告时序注意力排名信息并不等于事故证据定位；对象流贡献远弱于视觉流；重复帧删除与语义移除可产生不同、甚至反向的概率变化。作者据此展示多方法解释审计与干预语义检查的价值。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 仅摘要级；SSRN详情页返回403，全文未核；任务是道路事故识别，不是伪造/篡改/真实性判定；删除效应不等同于因果忠实性完整验证。
screening_conclusion: 保留为视频视觉XAI方法邻接，为解释定位与删除协议提供可迁移方法线索；不计入直接图像鉴伪强相关论文数。

paper: MSU Team at the Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge 2026: Grounded Artifact Evidence for Deepfake Detection
verified_identity: Artem Filippov, Aleksandr Gushchin, Kirill Koltsov, Dmitriy Vatolin & Anastasia Antsiferova; ACM Multimedia 2026 forthcoming proceedings, DOI 10.1145/3767308.3838609; arXiv:2610.09952v1 (2026-10-07); official full text.
relevance_class: 直接相关：图像鉴伪系统中的局部伪影证据图与生成解释接地
scope_and_methods: Challenge submission on XPlainVerse; fuses DINOv3 and Mesorch visual features, generates Grounding-DINO pseudo masks from artifact phrases in training explanations to supervise patch-level Artifact Evidence Map, and generates class-conditional Qwen3-VL complex explanations plus a GRPO simplifier. On the 200K final test reports accuracy .9349, explanation score .5571 and final score .7456. Separate internal explanation evaluation uses 10K samples and only outputs whose final classification is correct.
observed_reliability_evidence: Maps explanation-derived artifact phrases to image patches and evaluates textual entity/evidence grounding using the challenge's LLM-based metric; reports nontrivial evidence score (.3932 in final result). This is direct evidence of a practical grounding pipeline, not validation that the map or claims are faithful.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Patch targets are pseudo masks produced by Grounding DINO from text, not independent manipulation ground truth; no Evidence Map IoU/pointing benchmark against pixel-level tamper masks is reported. Explanation score inherits reference-text/LLM evaluator limits. The internal language-generation analysis excludes detector-wrong predictions; the pipeline conditions the explainer on detector label without independently verifying that label/evidence. No human study, causal faithfulness, sanity check, explanation stability or appropriate reliance test. Authors note the VLM is attached after detection and does not verify detector evidence.
screening_conclusion: High-relevance direct system paper and a distinct new work identity. Include as a grounded-evidence pipeline, but do not treat pseudo-mask supervision or text-grounding scores as established explanation reliability. All 28 printed references title/topic screened in T612.

paper: Show me the evidence: Evaluating the role of evidence and natural language explanations in AI-supported fact-checking
verified_identity: Greta Warren, Jingyi Sun, Irina Shklovski, Isabelle Augenstein. FAccT ’26, pp. 4899–4934 (2026), DOI 10.1145/3805689.3812358; arXiv:2601.11387v1.
relevance_class: 跨领域强方法邻接：自然语言解释、证据检查和人类AI依赖；非图像/媒体取证直接证据。

paper: Can LLMs Produce Faithful Explanations For Fact-checking? Towards Faithful Explainable Fact-Checking via Multi-Agent Debate
verified_identity: Kyungha Kim, Sangyun Lee, Kung-Hsiang Huang, Hou Pong Chan, Manling Li, Heng Ji. arXiv:2402.07401v1, submitted 2024-02-12; no separate peer-reviewed venue was displayed in the consulted arXiv record.

screening_conclusion: 强方法邻接。可支持两条方法论判断：解释可靠性应按明确错误类型逐项对照底层证据；自动解释裁判需要用人工标注校准且可能与人类判读大幅不一致。只作为图像鉴伪研究的方法参照，不计视觉鉴伪直接实证论文。

paper: Do LVLMs Understand Charts? Analyzing and Correcting Factual Errors in Chart Captioning

paper: Is It Certainly a Deepfake? Reliability Analysis in Detection & Generation Ecosystem
verified_identity: Neslihan Kose, Anthony Rhodes, Umur Aybars Çiftçi, İlke Demir. ICCV Workshops 2025, pp. 279–289; DOI 10.1109/ICCVW69036.2025.00035; arXiv:2509.17550v3 (28 Oct 2025). CVF official bibliographic page and official arXiv full text cross-checked.
relevance_class: Reliability/uncertainty-method neighbor for deepfake detection; not direct evidence validating explanation reliability.
scope_and_methods: Full text §§1–9 reviewed. Experiments use FaceForensics++ and FakeAVCeleb, six detector families (four blind and two biological), nine generators, binary and source-detection tasks, leave-one-generator-out tests, Bayesian neural networks and MC dropout. It reports predictive/model uncertainty, accuracy retention/calibration, region ablations, and pixel-level Bayesian saliency and uncertainty maps. A simple black-box adversarial generator is used for robustness.
observed_reliability_evidence: Reports detector uncertainty and calibration/retention curves across generators. For example, on FF binary detection EfficientNet accuracy falls from 99.38% to 90.93% after Bayesian conversion, while FakeCatcher changes from 96.14% to 95.77%; source-detection and leave-one-out tables also show substantial architecture/generator variation. Pixel maps visualize uncertainty and saliency patterns.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The empirical reliability construct is detector prediction uncertainty/calibration/generalization, not explanation reliability. Saliency and uncertainty maps are presented as visualizations; no quantitative faithfulness/fidelity, manipulation-mask overlap, deletion/insertion, parameter-randomization sanity, independent human assessment or appropriate-reliance study is reported. Region ablation removes face regions from data/training analyses; it is not a causal intervention on the displayed explanation. Adversarial tests measure detector accuracy under attack, not explanation-map stability. Main source data are face videos and the paper is therefore a cross-modal deepfake neighbor to still-image forgery.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a high-value reliability/uncertainty-method neighbor because it directly studies deepfake detector calibration, generator shifts, robustness and spatial maps. Do not cite it as evidence that saliency/uncertainty explanations are faithful or factually grounded.

relevance_class: 任务邻接/司法视觉证据真实性基准；不是解释可靠性研究
scope_and_methods: 全文核读§§1–6：CIFAR Synthetic Evidence Corpus覆盖监控、行车记录仪、消费者照片；共1,505项（720 authentic、785 altered/fabricated），包括scene-condition edits、localized edits、full fabrications；27个prompt模板及来源/生成器/场景metadata。用四个公开检测器做zero-shot基线。
observed_reliability_evidence: 报告不同证据家庭、生成器与编辑等级间的检测失败结构，并指出d3最佳ROC-AUC仅0.674、默认阈值对真实证据假阳性和操纵漏检均有风险。该证据针对鉴伪系统的任务可靠性/外部适用性，可作为解释可靠性研究的司法部署场景背景。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 全文没有生成解释，也没有评价自然语言理由、显著图/归因可靠性、faithfulness、解释稳定性、人类判断或appropriate reliance。生成期间人工筛除失败样本不是正式标注，也未报告IAA；因此不得把该基准的检测可靠性结果写作解释可靠性证据。
screening_conclusion: 保留为司法视觉证据的任务邻接文献，帮助界定外部效度场景；不纳入解释可靠性直接证据或72强相关解释优先项。

paper: Interpretable DeepFake Detection Based on Frequency Spatial Transformer
verified_identity: Tao Luan, Guoqing Liang, Pengfei Pei; IJETAA 1(2), 19–25 (2024); DOI 10.62677/IJETAA.2402108.
relevance_class: 深伪检测/解释任务邻接；解释可靠性证据有限或未验证
scope_and_methods: 完整核读官方7页PDF：Find-X由frequency/spatial分支生成edge、pixel、region特征图，FTD据此做real/fake分类；评测包括FF++, Celeb-DF、DFD的分类准确率、分支消融和视频压缩条件。图3–4为不同操纵方式下的定性迹象图。
observed_reliability_evidence: 作者将edge/pixel/region图称为视觉解释；原文主要提供定性图示与分类准确率/消融/压缩测试，没有报告与独立伪造区域标注的IoU或其他解释ground truth对齐、参数随机化sanity check、删除/插入/反事实充分性或必要性、解释稳定性指标、解释人评或评分者一致性。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 压缩实验评的是检测性能而不是解释图鲁棒性；图示中视觉上落在篡改脸部区域也不是独立证据核验。模型输出“trace”与后验理由的区别尚待验证。不存在适当依赖研究。
screening_conclusion: 列为直接深伪视觉解释方法候选；完整文本支持其产生可视伪迹图，但不支持“解释可靠性已验证”。用户研究主题以静态图像为主时应标为视频/人脸邻接。

paper: Methods and Trends in Detecting AI-Generated Images: A Comprehensive Review
verified_identity: Arpan Mahara and Naphtali Rishe; arXiv:2502.15176v2 (2025); journal record PII S1574013726000171 (2026).
relevance_class: image authenticity/deepfake XAI survey; discovery source, not primary reliability evidence
scope_and_methods: Reviewed the official arXiv v2 HTML taxonomy, the sections on explainability/grounding and the review discussion/conclusion; checked the cited review claims against the accessible text.
observed_reliability_evidence: The review surveys explainability and grounded-reasoning approaches to synthetic-image detection and explicitly identifies the lack of standardized reliability evaluation protocols as a gap. It discusses human preference/user-study evidence in selected cited papers, which must be verified in those primary works.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: This is a narrative survey, not a primary experiment; review-level statements do not validate any particular map or rationale. Its search/selection method does not establish systematic-review exhaustiveness. The 2026 ScienceDirect page returned 403, so journal-version details were not independently inspected; the accessible arXiv full text was used.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a high-value discovery and terminology source. Follow its directly relevant primary citations, deduplicating them against the existing master ledger; do not count it as direct faithfulness evidence.

paper: Towards Explainable Fake Image Detection with Multi-Modal Large Language Models
verified_identity: Yikun Ji, Yan Hong, Jun Zhan, Haoxing Chen, Jun Lan, Huijia Zhu et al.; ACM Multimedia 2025; DOI 10.1145/3746027.3755421; arXiv:2504.14245v2.
relevance_class: AI-generated-image detection with explicit explanations/reasoning; direct task match
scope_and_methods: Read official arXiv v2 HTML methods, experiments, prompt ablations, qualitative outputs, rejection discussion and limitations. Six prompt strategies fuse MLLM image judgments; the study compares detection accuracy with detectors and human annotators.
observed_reliability_evidence: Uses human expertise to design prompts and reports classification accuracy against human performance (GPT-4o 93.4%, best human annotator 86.3% per the paper). It does not conduct a human rating of the truth, completeness or grounding of model-generated explanations.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The reported human comparison is a detection task, not an explanation-quality user study. The paper itself says future work should quantify human alignment and study how evaluators interpret generated explanations. Six prompt voting, qualitative rationales, and detector accuracy do not establish evidence faithfulness or causal reliance.
screening_conclusion: Direct synthetic-image detection with human-readable rationales; useful task/method neighbor, but no explanation-reliability endpoint in the reviewed evaluation.

paper: ForenX: Towards Explainable AI-Generated Image Detection with Multimodal Large Language Models
verified_identity: Chuangchuang Tan, Jinglu Wang, Xiang Ming, Renshuai Tao, Yunchao Wei, Yao Zhao, Yan Lu; arXiv:2508.01402v1 (2025).
relevance_class: AI-generated-image detection with explicit explanations/reasoning; direct task match
scope_and_methods: Read official arXiv v1 HTML method, annotation pipeline, experiments, prompt tests, qualitative examples, user study and appendices. ForenX uses LLaVA-8B/Llama-3 with a forensic prompt; 2,215 Midjourney images have manually boxed/described anomalies later summarized by GPT-4 Vision. The user study compares reasons on 100 images, rated by 20 users, with method labels hidden and answer order shuffled.
observed_reliability_evidence: Reports blind human ratings of generated reasons on accuracy, relevance, reasonableness, completeness and overall quality; ForenX is rated above LLaVA-FT. This is direct evidence about perceived explanation quality. Prompt-ablation tables also expose sensitivity: the reported mean accuracy drops from 97.8% for prompt v1 to 63.5% for v3 and 50.7% for v4.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: No annotator count by item, inter-rater agreement, independent audit of each factual claim, or calibrated adjudication is reported in the reviewed text. GPT-4V summarizes the manual boxes/descriptions, and the explanation score is subjective. Human quality ratings support perceived accuracy/relevance but do not establish causal faithfulness, counterfactual evidence necessity/sufficiency, explanation-map stability, or appropriate user reliance. Prompt robustness claims must be bounded by the severe task-prompt sensitivity shown in v3/v4.
screening_conclusion: Strong image-domain explanation-quality human-evaluation study and a primary candidate for review; among the retrieved direct papers, it provides human explanation ratings, but not causal faithfulness or reliance validation.

paper: ThinkFake: Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models for AI-Generated Image Detection
verified_identity: Tai-Ming Huang, Wei-Tung Lin, Kai-Lung Hua, Wen-Huang Cheng, Junichi Yamagishi, Jun-Cheng Chen; arXiv:2509.19841 (2025).
relevance_class: AI-generated-image detection with explicit explanations/reasoning; direct task match
scope_and_methods: Read official arXiv HTML method/reward functions, data annotation and filtering, GenImage and LOKI evaluations, qualitative examples, ablations and conclusion. The model emits structured reasoning and image-authenticity judgments; rewards include reasoning/JSON format, binary classification accuracy, and expert-agent outputs.
observed_reliability_evidence: SFT reasoning paths are generated by Gemini-1.4-Pro with ground-truth labels injected and rule-based filtering to 638 examples; the agentic reward trains against UnivFD/AIDE-derived artifact probabilities. The paper evaluates detection accuracy on GenImage and LOKI, including a satellite-image category, and provides qualitative rationale examples.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The ground truth used in reward is primarily binary real/fake classification, and agentic labels are detector outputs; neither verifies each generated evidence claim against an independent artifact annotation. No human explanation-quality study, claim-level factuality/grounding audit, causal faithfulness intervention, rationale stability test, or appropriate-reliance experiment was found in the reviewed evaluation. Format compliance and classification accuracy are not explanation accuracy.
screening_conclusion: Direct reasoning-based synthetic-image detector with hallucination-control training; its current evidence validates classification and output structure, not explanation reliability.

paper: Towards Generalizable and Interpretable AI-Modified Image Detectors

paper: Can Vision-Language Models Reason about AI Edits in Images?
verified_identity: Darsha Udayanga, Pin-Yu Chen, Payel Das, Qiang Ji; arXiv:2607.28464v1, submitted 30 Jul 2026; DOI 10.48550/arXiv.2607.28464
relevance_class: 图像AI编辑鉴伪/定位与推理轨迹生成：高任务相关；解释可靠性效度未验证
scope_and_methods: 以Qwen2.5-VL为VLM，经GRPO对局部AI编辑图像产生结构化reasoning trace、真假标签和粗框；奖励只有格式正确性及检测/定位准确性（真实样本分类奖励、编辑样本标签正确时bbox IoU）；后续冻结VLM，以推理轨迹和边框提示SAM细化掩膜。数据覆盖AutoSplice、MagicBrush、FFHQ-FM、SD_inpaint等，主要报告分类准确率、mIoU、eff-IoU/Pixel-F1。

paper: Evaluation of Image Forgery Detection Using Multi-Scale Weber Local Descriptors
verified_identity: Savita Walia, Krishan Kumar, Saurabh Agarwal, Hyunsung Kim; Symmetry 14(8), 1611 (2022); DOI 10.3390/sym14081611; official publisher full text
relevance_class: Direct image-manipulation XAI application; explanation reliability not empirically validated.
scope_and_methods: Official MDPI HTML full text reviewed. ELA-derived SD-LBP feature maps feed pretrained ResNet-50 v2 to classify authentic/manipulated images. Kernel SHAP is presented as feature selection/attribution; the paper shows SHAP summary/decision plots, including a normal-image example labelled reconstruction error 0.07. Experiments mainly report detector accuracy on CASIA v1/v2, IMD2020 and DVMM. Conclusion leaves manipulation localization as future work; this is not a pixel-grounded explanation benchmark.
observed_reliability_evidence: SHAP feature attribution plots and detector-performance comparisons are provided. These show that an attribution tool was applied, not that explanations were independently validated.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: No independent explanation target or claim annotations; no deletion/insertion, necessity/sufficiency, counterfactual, parameter-randomization sanity test, perturbation stability, human explanation-quality study, inter-rater agreement or trial-level appropriate reliance identified in the full text. Classification accuracy and illustrative SHAP plots do not establish explanation truth. Feature-level attribution over ELA/LBP/model features does not show that the explanation identifies true manipulated pixels.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a direct image-forgery XAI method and historical precedent, but classify reliability evidence as unvalidated. Do not cite detector accuracy or illustrative SHAP plots as proof of faithful forensic explanations.

paper: Deepfake Detection Using Optimized VGG16-Based Framework Enhanced with LIME for Secure Digital Content

paper: Counterfactual explanations for face forgery detection via adversarial removal of artifacts

paper: Interpretability is in the eye of the beholder: human versus artificial classification of image segments generated by humans versus XAI

paper: A Robust and Explainable Deepfake Detection Image Framework Using Transfer Learning with Attention Mechanism

paper: Explainable Image Similarity: Integrating Siamese Networks and Grad-CAM
verified_identity: Ioannis E. Livieris, Emmanuel Pintelas, Niki Kiriakidou, Panagiotis E. Pintelas; Journal of Imaging 9(10):224 (2023), published 2023-10-14; DOI 10.3390/jimaging9100224; PMID 37888331; PMCID PMC10606999; arXiv:2310.07678

paper: Weakly-supervised Localization of Manipulated Image Regions Using Multi-resolution Learned Features
verified_identity: Ziyong Wang; Charith Abhayaratne; arXiv:2505.23586v1 (29 May 2025)
relevance_class: Direct neighboring evidence: spatial localization of manipulated regions; not causal explanation faithfulness
scope_and_methods: Image-level manipulation detector WCBnet produces multi-view Grad-CAM activation maps, fused with segmentation masks from DeepLab/SAM/PSPNet via Bayesian inference. CASIA2.0; image-level F1 and pixel-wise heatmap-vs-ground-truth AUC/F1.

paper: Explainable Dual-Stream Attention Network for Image Forgery Detection and Localisation Using Contrastive Learning
verified_identity: Maryam Munawar; Mourad Oussalah; IET Radar, Sonar & Navigation 19 (2025), e70064; DOI 10.1049/rsn2.70064

paper: SEGNet: An Interpretable Framework with Selective Feature Learning for Deepfake Detection
verified_identity: Ruchika Sharma; Rudresh Dwivedi. SSRN 7231397; DOI 10.2139/ssrn.7231397; posted 2026-08-04; 52-page preprint, not peer reviewed

scope_and_methods: Reviewed sections on LIME/SHAP, methods, detector reliability/consistency, feature contribution, results, conclusion and all bibliography entries. SEGNet itself uses SHAP on extracted multimodal features; detection evaluated on World Leader and DeepfakeTIMIT datasets.
observed_reliability_evidence: The paper asserts that SHAP improves transparency, reliability and trust; reports detector accuracy and Kappa/CSI/Pearson/CCA agreement with class labels; presents SHAP global feature-importance plots. These support detector-performance/agreement and a qualitative XAI application only.

Section 4.6 “Reliability and Consistency” evaluates detector predictions against labels. No explanation-map ground-truth comparison, perturbation/necessity-sufficiency, parameter-randomization sanity check, explanation stability, deletion/insertion, or human comprehension/reliance study was found in the reviewed sections. Preprint has not been peer reviewed.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a direct application/reliability-claim example, but do not count as empirical evidence that the explanation is faithful or reliable. Abir et al. is a distinct, already audited strong topical candidate and is reused as reference [1].

paper: Training Better Deep Learning Models Using Human Saliency
verified_identity: Aidan Boyd, Patrick Tinsley, Kevin W. Bowyer, Adam Czajka; arXiv:2410.16190v1; posted 2024-10-21; preprint
relevance_class: Methodological adjacency: human-saliency alignment and across-run map stability in synthetic-face detection; not a post-hoc forensic explanation-validity study
scope_and_methods: Read official arXiv HTML sections III–V-C, V-F, and conclusion. CYBORG adds a human-saliency consistency term during training. In synthetic-face detection, non-expert observers classify real vs synthetic faces and annotate supporting regions. Experiments span DenseNet121, ResNet50, Inception-v3, ten independently trained models per architecture, with CAMs compared on held-out test samples to human saliency from training annotations.
observed_reliability_evidence: The authors visually report greater CAM consistency across independent runs and greater agreement with human saliency for CYBORG-trained models than conventional training. They also compare human-saliency training to random, inverted and Gaussian controls, and test open-set generalization to unseen generators. This is empirical evidence for stability and human-alignment of training-integrated saliency in synthetic-face detection.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The evidence is largely visual/qualitative for map consistency and human alignment; model detection AUC/AP are reported across runs, but these are not explanation-faithfulness metrics. Human saliency is part of training, so this is not an independent post-hoc explanation test. The paper does not report attribution randomization sanity checks, causal necessity/sufficiency or deletion/insertion, explanation-region ground truth for manipulated pixels, or a user comprehension/reliance study. Synthetic-face detection is narrower than general image tampering/splicing. Preprint not peer reviewed.
screening_conclusion: Retain as tier-2 methodological adjacency because it tests explanation-like CAM stability and human alignment on a synthetic-image authenticity task. Cite it to motivate human-alignment/stability tests, not as evidence that post-hoc explanations are causally faithful.

paper: Detecting Compressed Deepfake Images Using Two-Branch Convolutional Networks with Similarity and Classifier
verified_identity: Ping Chen, Ming Xu, Xiaodong Wang; Symmetry 14(12), 2691 (2022); DOI 10.3390/sym14122691
relevance_class: Direct image authenticity/deepfake detection explanation application; qualitative Grad-CAM consistency across compression perturbations
scope_and_methods: Read the official MDPI full text. TCNSC uses a similarity branch for raw/compressed image representations and a binary authenticity classifier on FaceForensics++. Section 4 visualizes Grad-CAM for real/fake images across raw, high-, medium-, and low-quality compression settings.
observed_reliability_evidence: Figure 4 offers a qualitative cross-input consistency check: the authors state that the main attention regions remain broadly symmetric across compression conditions. This is directly relevant to whether visual explanations persist under a common image-quality transformation.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The figure is qualitative and the article primarily evaluates detector accuracy/robustness, not explainer reliability. No numerical CAM stability score, human-annotated manipulation-mask alignment, causal deletion/insertion, parameter-randomization sanity check, or user comprehension/reliance test was found. Similarity of maps alone does not prove causal faithfulness.
screening_conclusion: Retain as tier-2 direct methodological neighbor and a concrete precedent for testing explanation stability under compression. Do not treat its detector accuracy as explanation validity or its qualitative heatmaps as a formal faithfulness result.

paper: Learning Spatiotemporal Inconsistency via Thumbnail Layout for Face Deepfake Detection
verified_identity: Yuting Xu, Jian Liang, Lijun Sheng, Xiao-Yu Zhang; International Journal of Computer Vision 132 (2024); DOI 10.1007/s11263-024-02054-2; arXiv:2403.10261v2

No region-overlap score against manipulation masks, causal faithfulness, parameter-randomization sanity test, or human explanation-use study is reported in the reviewed sections.
screening_conclusion: Retain as tier-2 explanation-localization adjacency. Correct the earlier overinclusive reliability/evidence co-occurrence status: detection robustness must not be counted as explanation reliability.

paper: Perceptual Artifacts Localization for Image Synthesis Tasks
verified_identity: Lingzhi Zhang et al.; ICCV 2023; arXiv:2310.05590v1 (2023-10-09); official full text https://arxiv.org/html/2310.05590
relevance_class: 直接邻接：AI-generated image authenticity detector Grad-CAM与人类感知伪影mask的空间接地评价；任务主体是感知伪影定位/修复，不是篡改图真实性判定。
scope_and_methods: 全文核读§§2–4及附录所列实验。构建10,168幅跨10种图像合成任务的人类逐像素伪影标签（约170标注工时），训练伪影语义分割模型。作为基线，作者对real/fake classifier CNNgenerates计算Grad-CAM，并将其“fake”热区和人工感知伪影掩码比较；Patch Forensics与PAL4Inpaint也作为热图/定位基线。
observed_reliability_evidence: Table 1报告CNNgenerates+Grad-CAM对人工伪影mask的mIoU约0.48–7.13，具体随10类任务变化；例如StyleGAN2为4.38、文本到图像为0.51、虚拟试穿为2.56。§4.1明确发现该分类器解释与人的“fake/artifact”感知显著不同。Table 2在未见生成器上的mIoU也低（0.12–3.67）。这是直接空间接地/人类感知一致性证据，可揭示检测热图并未定位可见伪影。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Grad-CAM与人工伪影掩码的空间重合度不是因果faithfulness：没有遮除/插入或反事实干预以测量证据必要性/充分性，也未做参数随机化sanity或对同一固定模型的解释稳定性测试。该分割模型本身直接接受人类伪影mask监督，其mIoU是定位任务质量，不可替代分类解释有效性。论文的多人用户投票评估的是自动修复后的图像优劣，不是对解释理解、可信度或适当依赖的用户研究。图像域是生成伪影，不等同于传统拼接/复制移动篡改。
screening_conclusion: 全文/附录核读。提升为直接邻接证据：提供了“鉴伪模型Grad-CAM是否对准人类可感知伪影”的负向定量证据；需与因果忠实性、解释稳定性和用户依赖构念明确区分。

paper: Deepfake Algorithm Using Multiple Noise Modalities with Two-Branch Prediction Network

paper: Decision-Aid Framework for Face Authentication Detection Using ResNext50 and BiLSTM to Enhance Media Integrity
verified_identity: Ayat Abd-Muti Alrawahneh et al.; IEEE Access 13 (2025), 89858–89873; DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2025.3569792
