screening_conclusion: 纳入高优先直接候选；属于“有显式区域真值支撑的解释训练方法，但没有独立解释可靠性效度评估”。在最终综述中将作者的hallucination mitigation主张与实际验证证据分开报告。

paper: EditScout: Locating Forged Regions from Diffusion-based Edited Images with Multimodal LLM
verified_identity: Quang Nguyen, Truong Vu, Trong-Tung Nguyen, Yuxin Wen, Preston K Robinette, Taylor T Johnson, Tom Goldstein, Anh Tran, Khoi Nguyen. arXiv:2412.03809v1 (2024-12-05). Stable identity L-ef157d3d0f32eb.
relevance_class: 高优先任务/空间接地邻接：扩散编辑伪造区域定位，MLLM生成编辑指令并产生分割掩码；不是解释可靠性直接实证。
primary_source: Official arXiv v1 full text: https://arxiv.org/html/2412.03809v1 ; record: https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.03809.
scope_and_methods: 核读官方v1 §§1, 3–6。输入疑似扩散编辑图像，LLaVA按提示生成“The edited region is [SEG], and the edit instruction used is c”；[SEG]被转为分割查询并由SAM解码掩码。训练以编辑指令交叉熵及掩码BCE/Dice损失监督。以MagicBrush、AutoSplice训练，在MagicBrush、CocoGLIDE及含未见BrushNet编辑的PerfBrush测试，指标为mask mIoU/F1；报告提示模板敏感性分析。
observed_reliability_evidence: 编辑区域掩码相对GT的mIoU/F1构成空间定位接地代理；指令文本有GT监督；未见编辑类型测试和提示词敏感性分析提供一定泛化/输入敏感性信息。作者称编辑指令提供清晰解释。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 作者在§6明确说明模型不能解释特定编辑为何发生。指令CE是训练监督，不是独立的解释事实性审计；mask mIoU/F1只评价区域定位，不证明文本指令正确、完整或忠实于模型实际决策。提示模板敏感性是任务输出敏感性，不是重复运行解释稳定性测试。未见独立人类/专家解释评分、rater agreement、反事实/删除插入或参数随机化sanity、用户appropriate reliance。
screening_conclusion: 纳入高优先的图像取证任务/空间接地邻接论文；综述中可作为“带文字编辑指令与区域监督，但解释可靠性尚未验证”的证据。不能将mask定位性能写成解释可信度。

paper: Fully AI-Generated Image Detection: Definition, Recent Advances and Challenges
verified_identity: Qijie Xu, Can Wang, Jiawei Chen, Siwei Lyu, Defang Chen; arXiv:2502.19716v3 (2026-07-15). Stable identity L-bcd10167ef7ad8.
relevance_class: 高优先主题综述邻接：在图像生成鉴伪的MLLM解释章节明确指出解释可能空泛、牵强并虚构不存在的视觉缺陷；非原始效度实验。
primary_source: Official arXiv v3 HTML: https://arxiv.org/html/2502.19716 ; record: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.19716.
scope_and_methods: 全文核读v3 §4.5及参考文献。该review梳理全AI生成图像检测，§4.5描述MLLM视觉问答式检测：模型报告伪影是否存在、所在区域和分类；指出模型在模糊纹理、不自然度、细微色偏等非物理伪迹的解释可能空泛/牵强，且可能为了迎合提示而编造缺陷。该节讨论并引用Spot the Fake与AIGI-Holmes。
observed_reliability_evidence: 提供与本题高度相关的明确失效模式定义：解释声称的缺陷可能并不存在，造成不可靠取证证据。其综述概括可为构念界定、风险分类和回查一手研究提供依据。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 这是叙述性/系统梳理检测方法的综述，并未在本文中对解释输出做独立样本审计、专家盲评、事实正确率/IAA、解释扰动稳定性或用户适当依赖实验。不能把综述的风险陈述当作其自身的新实证结果；需沿§4.5 references回查所引原始论文。
screening_conclusion: 纳入高优先主题综述邻接；其“虚构不存在缺陷”表述直接触及图像鉴伪解释事实性，是检索与引文追踪的重要线索，但效度结论仍需一手实证支撑。

paper: Can VLMs Detect and Localize Fine-Grained AI-Edited Images?
verified_identity: Zhen Sun et al.; arXiv:2505.15644v2 (2025)
relevance_class: 强任务/解释接地邻接：图像编辑真实性检测和局部定位；非直接解释可靠性实证
scope_and_methods: FragFake覆盖6种编辑器及增添、替换、背景改变、人脸表情编辑；98,412张编辑图。模型输出 real/edited 与编辑对象/区域；检测用Acc/F1、定位用Region Precision (RP)与Object Precision (OP)。RLVR的可解释性通过输出格式、二分类与定位自动奖励优化。RP由标注者看原图、编辑图、真值描述和模型输出判断预测对象/区域是否落在对应位置，所有人工标注由两位作者交叉检查。
observed_reliability_evidence: 作者称GRPO/RLVR使模型输出更可解释；人类评测提供定位结果与人工区域判断的比较。OP依赖Qwen3-4B自动语义等价裁判，RP是较宽松的人类判断。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 人类研究比较非专家与模型在检测和定位上的能力，不是人类对模型解释真实性的盲评；RP/OP评估检测定位而非自由文本理由真值。自动judge、像素/对象定位指标不等价于解释事实性或因果faithfulness；未见解释稳定性、sanity check或appropriate reliance测试。
screening_conclusion: 纳入强任务邻接与解释/定位评测设计参考；引用时不得作为直接证明图像鉴伪解释可靠性的实证。

paper: Exploring Saliency Bias in Manipulation Detection
verified_identity: Joshua Krinsky, Alan Bettis, Qiuyu Tang, Daniel Moreira, Aparna Bharati; IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP) 2024; DOI 10.1109/ICIP51287.2024.10648063; arXiv:2402.07338v4 (2025-03-28).
relevance_class: 强邻接：真实图像篡改的人类注意/篡改区域标注与显著性偏差；不是XAI解释评估
scope_and_methods: 全文§§3–6及结论核读。用户研究：RT数据集130张拼接图，65名参与者，每图5次标注、总650次响应；分别框出最吸引注意区域和疑似篡改区域，与像素级篡改真值对照。机器测试扩展到RT、MFC18、IMD2020，并比较PSCC-Net、OSN、BusterNet、ManTra-Net；另用SaGIM提高篡改区域显著性并重测。
observed_reliability_evidence: 人工saliency与篡改区域定位有外部像素真值对照；低到高显著性组的人类定位AuROC约从0.62升至0.89。多个检测器也随篡改显著性升高而表现变好；显著性增强使多数模型的性能差距收窄。说明人类视觉注意/可见性会影响真伪判断与定位，可作为人类热图/XAI空间一致性解释的混杂因素警示。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 论文没有评估任何模型的post-hoc解释图、解释文本或解释忠实度；不测人机依赖/信任。人工注意框是感知显著性而非模型决策因果依据；人工定位和机器定位都与saliency相关，故人类重合不等于取证理由正确。样本主要为静态拼接图且人为评审规模有限；检测域为三套数据集。
screening_conclusion: 纳入强邻接证据，用于解释人工显著图对齐的构念边界和评估偏差；不得计入直接图像鉴伪XAI reliability/faithfulness研究数量。

paper: Saliency-R1: Enforcing Interpretable and Faithful Vision-language Reasoning via Saliency-map Alignment Reward
verified_identity: Shizhan Gong, Minda Hu, Qiyuan Zhang, Chen Ma, Qi Dou; arXiv:2604.04500v1, 2026-04-06.
relevance_class: 方法学邻接：VLM视觉显著图删除/插入faithfulness与人评；非图像鉴伪研究
scope_and_methods: 通用VLM视觉问答。以token logits分解和attention rollout生成显著图，以人工标注框中的显著性质量作为GRPO训练奖励。用COCO Caption、OpenPSG及附录中的GranDf做删除/插入测试，按像素扰动5/15/30%衡量模型输出概率变化。附录E.5让12名志愿者对10个VQA样例的显著图解释质量按1–5打分，描述标准为视觉连贯、与问题相关、与思维过程及最终答案有关。
observed_reliability_evidence: 作者报告删除分数越低、插入分数越高的显著区域对模型响应影响越强；GranDf补充结果亦含删除/插入。人评均分为基线3.6、Saliency-R1 4.5，Wilcoxon signed-rank p<0.05。构成faithfulness干预代理与感知质量小样本人评两种互补证据。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 不是图像取证/伪造检测任务；VQA重要区域并非伪造证据真值。删除/插入受基线图像、替换方式和输出概率定义影响，属于特定扰动下的因果敏感性指标，不自动证明解释完整地呈现模型内部原因。12人仅评10例，未报告独立事实真值、评审间一致性或用户适当依赖。作者也承认基于直接logit贡献的显著图可能不如梯度/扰动方法faithful，并使用边界框这一粗标签。
screening_conclusion: 保留为方法学邻接：可参考其把删除/插入与小规模人评并列，但不得把通用VQA结果当作图像鉴伪解释可靠性证据。

paper: Seeing through Deepfakes: An Explainable Multi-Task Detection Framework with Deep Learning and Large Language Models
verified_identity: Jiyeong Park, Sercan Yeşilköy, Doyeon Lim, Huiryeong Park, Eunseo Lee, Mohsen Ali Alawami, Ki-Woong Park; Computers, Materials & Continua 89(1), article 18 (2026-08-13); DOI 10.32604/cmc.2026.081091.
relevance_class: 直接深伪解释管线与解释质量评价候选；LLM评审型证据，非真人验证
scope_and_methods: 全文核读。CNN-LSTM多任务检测；Grad-CAM生成ROI统计；结构化ROI/预测信息提示Llama3输出文本理由。文本与ROI激活统计进行定性一致性检查。解释质量ablation在60个正确分类视频（30 real/30 fake）上进行成对比较，解释由Llama3生成，两个LLM评审者为Llama3和GPT-4o，标准含decision justification、faithfulness to provided evidence、specificity、completeness和non-expert interpretability。
observed_reliability_evidence: 提供解释内容与模型证据的一项定性一致性检查，以及双LLM评审的相对偏好结果：加入ROI后相对Binary+Method，Llama3和GPT-4o分别在75.0%和81.7%的样本偏好ROI解释；fake样本偏好更高。这里测到的是LLM评审的解释质量偏好，不是对每条证据主张独立查真的准确率。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 作者明确表示未做human-subject validation；一致性检查是定性地核对文本是否提及Grad-CAM ROI中激活最高的区域，不报告定量解释一致性指标。成对比较只取正确分类的60个视频，使用两个LLM评审且解释生成也由Llama3完成，存在评审/生成模型偏倚；没有因果faithfulness（删除/插入/反事实）、独立ground-truth artifact claim audit、解释扰动稳定性或真人appropriate-reliance测量。
screening_conclusion: 保留为直接深伪解释质量评价候选，全文已核。它把evidence faithfulness操作化为LLM评审标准并检查ROI-文本一致性，但由于无人类受试及无量化/因果验证，不能作为人类解释可靠性或faithfulness已证实的强实证。

paper: Explanation-Guided Adversarial Training for Robust and Interpretable Models
verified_identity: Chao Chen, Yanhui Chen, Shanshan Lin, Dongsheng Hong, Shu Wu, Xiangwen Liao, Chuanyi Liu; arXiv:2603.01938v1 (2026-03-02); arXiv source includes IEEE copyright notice; venue issue not inferred from that notice.
relevance_class: General image-XAI robustness/faithfulness method neighbor; no image-forensics task
scope_and_methods: Official full text reviewed §§V-A–V-J. EGAT combines adversarial training, explanation-guided region alignment, attribution-map consistency under PGD and mixup attribution matching. Benchmarks are VLCS and Terra Incognita general object classification; evaluation reports clean/adversarial accuracy and comprehensiveness/sufficiency, with OOD and attack case studies. Grayscale image is used as a proxy map for visually meaningful regions.
observed_reliability_evidence: The study explicitly targets attributional stability under adversarial perturbations and evaluates explanation quality with comprehensiveness and sufficiency; it also discusses OOD behavior. This makes it a useful transferable evaluation/method reference for a forensic explanation study.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Neither benchmark is an image-forgery, deepfake, or media-authenticity task; no forensic artifact ground truth, independent claim-level evidence audit, or human reliance study is reported. Adversarial map stability alone does not establish that a forensic explanation identifies the true manipulation cue. The grayscale proxy is not an independent expert explanation mask. Do not count this as a direct forensic-reliability study.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a methodological neighbor only. It supports testing explanation stability and perturbation faithfulness, while emphasizing that stable maps can still focus on misleading regions; transfer to image forensics requires domain-specific ground truth and task evaluation.

paper: Deepfakebuster: a confidence-calibrated adaptive ensemble framework for robust Deepfake image detection
relevance_class: Method neighbor; not direct forensic evidence
scope_and_methods: Scientific Reports paper proposes a confidence-calibrated adaptive ensemble for deepfake image detection and reports calibration/reliability behavior; it includes a qualitative forensic indicator/interpretation module. The evaluated object is principally detector confidence/ensemble reliability.
observed_reliability_evidence: Full-text review: reliability-aware confidence calibration is central; interpretation is qualitative and presented as supporting forensic cues. No quantitative attribution faithfulness, causal deletion/insertion test of the explanation, region-mask alignment, explanation uncertainty calibration, or human appropriate-reliance experiment was identified in the reviewed text.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Detector confidence calibration cannot stand in for explanation correctness or explanation faithfulness. It is a close task neighbor, not direct validation of explanation reliability.
screening_conclusion: Retain as detection-confidence/calibration neighbor; exclude from direct explanation-reliability evidence.

paper: Benchmarking the influence of pre-training on explanation performance in MR image classification
relevance_class: Method neighbor; not direct forensic evidence
scope_and_methods: Full article constructs realistic MRI classification images by overlaying synthetic lesions with known locations; compares XAI heat maps with ground-truth lesion masks and evaluates how pretraining domain/fine-tuning affect explanation performance. Includes random-model and edge-detector baselines; this is medical imaging rather than forensic media.
observed_reliability_evidence: Full-text review: explanation maps are objectively scored against known lesion regions; popular XAI methods vary substantially even on correctly classified cases, and performance depends on pretraining domain and fine-tuning. This is concrete image-level ground-truth evaluation and a transferable benchmark design.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The ground-truth is synthetic medical lesions, not tampering masks or authentic/forged evidence; no forensic artifacts, image manipulation, or user trust/reliance are studied. Mask overlap is one operationalization, not a universal causal-faithfulness guarantee.
screening_conclusion: Retain as cross-domain image-XAI evaluation method neighbor; never count as a direct image-forensics paper.

paper: Quantifying Uncertainty in Natural Language Explanations of Large Language Models
verified_identity: PMLR-v238-harsha-tanneru24a
relevance_class: Method neighbor; not direct forensic evidence
scope_and_methods: Full PMLR paper studies uncertainty in generated natural-language explanations of LLM answers, using verbalized confidence and perturbation-based sample/model probing across math word problems and commonsense reasoning benchmarks.
observed_reliability_evidence: Full-text review: verbalized self-confidence is not a reliable estimate of explanation confidence; probing uncertainty from paraphrase/model perturbations correlates with explanation faithfulness, with lower uncertainty generally associated with higher faithfulness.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Experiments are text/NLP reasoning, not visual attribution, image evidence grounding, manipulated-image detection, or human reliance. Correlation does not establish that uncertainty is a calibrated probability of explanation correctness.
screening_conclusion: Retain as cross-domain explanation-uncertainty/faithfulness method neighbor; not direct image-forensics evidence.

paper: MARE: Multimodal Alignment and Reinforcement for Explainable Deepfake Detection via Vision-Language Models
relevance_class: Strong method neighbor; explanation-generation/alignment, not direct independent reliability validation
scope_and_methods: Official arXiv v5 full text: explainable deepfake detection with vision-language models; combines text-spatial alignment, RLHF and automated reward terms for detection accuracy, textual relevance, ROI and alignment. Uses image-text data with automated face-region/bounding-box pipeline.
observed_reliability_evidence: The paper measures detector AUC/accuracy and reasoning-task accuracy/F1, plus text-similarity and box/ROI alignment metrics. It does not report a separately designed blind human explanation-quality study, rater count/agreement, claim-level factual audit, hallucination measure, causal perturbation faithfulness test, or human reliance calibration in the reviewed v5 text.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: RLHF/prompt preference and region-text alignment are training objectives, not independent evidence that explanations are factually correct or causally faithful. Automated face-region labels and evaluation similarity may reward format/content overlap. ACM MM dates are future on the review date.
screening_conclusion: Retain as strong task/method neighbor. Do not count it as validated explanation reliability; distinguish its alignment/reward objectives from independent outcome validity.

paper: PATE-Forensics: Perception-as-Tool for Explainable Deepfake Forensics with General-Purpose MLLMs
verified_identity: Li et al.; arXiv:2608.18573v1
relevance_class: 直接解释候选：图像深伪检测/定位与MLLM解释；有显式解释rubric，评分者效度未知
scope_and_methods: DINOv3多粒度工具输出fake概率、patch/segment证据图及掩码；通用Qwen3.5-Flash MLLM按结构化视觉上下文和提示生成解释。DDL-X Track 3报告检测ACC、定位IoU、BERTScore和rubric分数。温度/top-p沿API默认设置，论文未给出数值。§4.1合并DDL-I原train/val，并将原test随机拆为90%训练、10%验证供内部开发。
observed_reliability_evidence: 官方八项rubric分别考察主体事实、可观察视觉证据接地、区域定位、伪迹/一致性分析、标签正确与预测忠实、解释文字-预测框空间对齐、避免环境幻觉、清晰性；每项0–2分并赋权（官方挑战规范）。BERTScore是文本相似度指标；表1报告的BERT/Rub.为综合分量。该协议对解释内容与定位/标签的一致性提供有限直接评分证据。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 论文与挑战说明均未识别rubric评分者、评分人数或评审一致性；不应称为经验证的人类评分。没有独立事实核查、因果扰动/faithfulness、解释跨运行稳定性或appropriate-reliance实验。文本由MLLM读取模型自身预测掩码/框并在提示中标签条件化，不能仅凭空间对齐推断解释因果依赖检测器证据。原test重新划作训练/验证仅是内部开发协议；官方挑战评分来自其测试流程，不宜将开发拆分说成独立测试。
screening_conclusion: 保留为直接相关解释系统及有限rubric评分证据；八项标准可用于评测指标设计，但评分者效度、因果faithfulness、稳定性和人类依赖仍未得到证明。其25条参考文献已逐项筛查，见sidecar及74/87。

paper: MMFusion: Combining Image Forensic Filters for Visual Manipulation Detection and Localization
verified_identity: Triaridis, Tsigos & Mezaris; arXiv:2312.01790v2
relevance_class: 直接方法证据：多取证filter的扰动归因/决策依赖；非自然语言解释
scope_and_methods: 逐次将NoisePrint++、Bayar Conv或SRM一个filter输入置零/替换为随机无篡改图，计算五个数据集上的像素级定位F1下降，以估计各取证证据源贡献。
observed_reliability_evidence: 在有GT时用真实定位F1变化作扰动解释；另提出blind Drop-in-Prediction-Quality，以原始未遮蔽预测作伪GT比较遮蔽后mask。两种指标跨数据集给出滤波器重要性结果。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: GT条件下只测模态/filter贡献，不验证像素热图解释的必要/充分性或文本主张；blind PQ以原始模型预测作为自身参照，不能独立认证该预测正确。解释依赖GT mask限制真实野外场景适用。
screening_conclusion: 纳入强相关的输入证据依赖/扰动解释先例；作为XAI可靠性的一种组件级方法，不宣称已解决完整解释faithfulness。

paper: ForgeReason: Multimodal Reasoning with Multi-Agent Collaboration for Generalizable and Explainable Image Forgery Detection
verified_identity: Omar Mansour, Mahmoud Elsharif, Karim Abdelnour, Yasmine Fouad; Research Square v1 posted 2026-06-11/12; DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-9996988/v1; explicitly not peer reviewed.
relevance_class: 直接相关：静态图像伪造检测与文本解释的人类质量评价；解释因果可靠性证据不足
scope_and_methods: Full-text browser review on 2026-10-15. Dual spatial ViT/frequency SRM streams, cross-modal reasoning alignment, and visual/frequency/reasoning agents. §4.4 evaluates 200 randomly selected test images; three expert annotators rate correctness (whether the explanation identifies the forgery), specificity (location/type), and helpfulness (aids understanding) on 1–5 Likert. Table 3 reports FakeShield 3.42/3.18/3.35, ReAlign 3.67/3.45/3.58, ForgeReason 4.21/3.93/4.08.
observed_reliability_evidence: Direct human-rated perceived explanation quality on three dimensions, including correctness and location/type specificity; independent of classification accuracy table and more informative than a model-only claim of explainability.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Unreviewed Research Square preprint. Only three experts; no reported inter-rater agreement, assignment/overlap details, blinding, uncertainty intervals, significance test, or external replication. Correctness is rated by annotators but the procedure for independent claim-by-claim adjudication against original image/ground-truth mask is not described. No deletion/insertion or counterfactual sufficiency/necessity, parameter randomization, causal decision-faithfulness, or user appropriate-reliance experiment. Explanations use image features, fused features, detection score and localization mask; subjective quality ratings do not establish that the detection verdict causally depends on the verbalized evidence.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a strong direct human-rated explanation-quality study, clearly labeled non-peer-reviewed and methodologically limited. Supports perceived correctness/specificity/helpfulness only; does not prove causal faithfulness or appropriate reliance.

paper: Mandela-Bench: Multimodal Models Remember Canonical Images Instead of Seeing Them
verified_identity: Yicheng Bao, Zhenkun Gao, Xiahui Guo, Mingqian Yang, Xueheng Li, Bangwei Liu, Mingang Chen, Lijun Li, Xuhong Wang, Xin Tan; arXiv:2609.32763v1, submitted 2026-09-26.
relevance_class: 直接相关：知识型图像篡改的事实矛盾识别、证据接地与评审器人类校准；非检测器因果faithfulness研究
scope_and_methods: 官方HTML全文核读。1,507项knowledge-only edit（1,359知识冲突伪造、148 anchor-free控制）及474张未改真实图；比较36个多模态模型。证据E0–E4由Qwen3.8-27B评审器按图像记录的事实矛盾评分；E3+要求正确定位被操纵实体/事实，E4要求指出特定事实矛盾。210条回复经盲法人工标注，206条可配对模型评审。
observed_reliability_evidence: 模型评审器对人工标注 exact agreement 82.5%、quadratic-weighted κ=.89、within-one-level 96.1%、E3+阈值一致率95.2%；另一评审器 exact agreement 91.5%、within-one-level 96.5%。以来源对齐事实冲突评分使“提到相关物体”与“指出具体被伪造事实”区分开，直接覆盖解释事实性/接地；同时对自动评审器作人工校准。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 研究对象是知识型图像编辑/篡改，不覆盖全部拼接、复制移动或一般局部取证。人工标签用于评审器校准，不是普通用户依赖实验。正确指出事实冲突不证明该理由是检测器实际使用的因果证据；未见删除/插入、反事实必要/充分性、参数随机化或appropriate-reliance操纵。LLM judge及基准构造仍可能带偏。
screening_conclusion: 强相关直接证据，纳入核心目录并显式标注构念边界：可支持事实性/证据接地评测和评审器人类校准，不能称作模型因果faithfulness或用户信任/依赖验证。

paper: Not Every Cue Is Evidence: Cue Supportability for Forensic Distillation in Face Forgery Detection
verified_identity: Binjia Zhou, Dawei Luo, Shuai Chen, Feng Xu, Haoyuan Li, Jia Wen Seow, Jiachi Wang, Jie Lei, Zunlei Feng, Yijun Bei; arXiv:2610.16452v1; submitted 2026-10-12; preprint.
relevance_class: 直接核心：图像取证解释的视觉证据支持性、正确答案但错误证据及评价器人类校准
scope_and_methods: Explainable face-forgery detection. Defines correct-answer/wrong-evidence (CAWE) separately from classification accuracy. Before privileged distillation, a text-side transfer-utility audit masks the target cue to test whether it is copied from annotation, and a visual-sensitivity audit compares equal-size top-/bottom-attribution image-token zeroing effects on cue likelihood. Evaluated across eight face-forgery benchmarks. Human study samples 3,600 image-cue pairs across six benchmarks; each pair rated by three of ten annotators. A further 1,000 FF++ cues test score-bin correlation with human support labels.
observed_reliability_evidence: The paper reports CAWE reductions of 10.8–14.8 percentage points over the strongest explainable baselines on four main benchmarks (about 28–41% relative, derived from table values), while maintaining/improving detection accuracy. Human majority support rates for the proposed method are 80–90% across six benchmarks versus 21–51% for generation-pipeline ground-truth cues. The trained VLM evaluator has 87.4% accuracy, F1 90.2%, Cohen κ=.72 against three-human majority labels on the 3,600 image-cue pairs. The 1,000-cue FF++ validation shows monotonic support rates across score bins.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Preprint v1, not a peer-reviewed final record at screening time. Domain is face forgery and single-turn English explanations. The human study validates cue support judgments and the evaluator, not whether users appropriately rely on a detector. The audit evaluates cues independently, only filters teacher-provided candidates, and may miss cue interactions or unannotated evidence. The visual intervention is attribution-guided token zeroing with a high-vs-low comparison; it is stronger than plausibility ratings but not a comprehensive causal necessity/sufficiency test of the model prediction. The method depends on attribution quality and fixed hyperparameters.
screening_conclusion: Strong direct core evidence for claim-level visual supportability and evaluator calibration in face-forgery explanations. Count as a new work identity. Do not generalize its human study to appropriate reliance, and do not equate its supportability intervention with complete causal-faithfulness validation.

paper: Can Multi-modal (reasoning) LLMs detect document manipulation?
verified_identity: Zisheng Liang et al.; arXiv:2508.11021v1; arXiv record submitted 2025-08-14. Embedded HTML body contains an inconsistent “August 24, 2026” date; identity follows the arXiv abstract record.
relevance_class: 文档图像取证任务邻接：检测置信度校准与理由错误分析；非解释可靠性直接实证
scope_and_methods: Benchmarks multimodal LLMs and traditional methods on receipt/document forgery using FindIt Again/RDDFD. Prompts solicit authenticity judgments and reasoning. Reports AUC, analyzes GPT-O1 failures/confidence distribution, and qualitatively describes arithmetic, temporal, document-consistency, and visual-anomaly cues.
observed_reliability_evidence: GPT-O1 is reported at AUC .71; the focused analysis reports 161/192 correct, with 29 false negatives concentrated below .05 confidence. It notes underconfidence and qualitatively discusses missed red flags when the model over-relies on internal arithmetic consistency. This is detector confidence/error analysis that can inform reliance risk, not an explanation-faithfulness metric.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: No independent claim-level verification that generated reasoning statements are visually supported; no omission/sufficiency intervention, explanation-stability evaluation, human explanation rating, or user appropriate-reliance study. The HTML says “218 receipt images” while the focused GPT-O1 analysis uses 192, and its embedded date conflicts with the arXiv v1 submission date; quantitative details should be treated cautiously.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a task-adjacent source on detector confidence calibration and reasoning-error modes for document-image forensics. Do not count it as direct evidence that explanations are faithful or reliable.

paper: AI as a Decision Support Tool in Forensic Image Analysis: A Pilot Study on Integrating Large Language Models Into Crime Scene Investigation Workflows
verified_identity: Shai Farber; Journal of Forensic Sciences 70(3), 932–943 (2025); DOI 10.1111/1556-4029.70035; first published 2025-04-04; SSRN 6289898 is the same article.
relevance_class: Strong adjacent: human-expert review of LLM-generated forensic image-analysis reports and reliability/confirmation-bias concerns.
scope_and_methods: Official Wiley full text screened. Three general-purpose multimodal systems (ChatGPT-4, Claude, Gemini) analyzed 30 edited/simulated crime-scene images; 10 retired forensic experts with at least five years of experience rated the outputs on a 1–10 rubric and provided written/open-ended comments. Rubric covered observation accuracy, comprehensiveness, evidence identification, logical inference, and overall reliability. The experts performed independent analyses before reviewing AI reports; no controlled AI-assisted versus unaided decision outcome was measured.
observed_reliability_evidence: Mean expert overall reliability rating was 7.4/10. The error taxonomy reports object misidentification (32%), missed critical evidence (30%), unfounded conclusions (24%), and distance/size estimation errors (14%). Experts raised confirmation-bias/overreliance concerns; this is qualitative caution and expert assessment of generated analyses.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Images are crime-scene interpretation cases, not a benchmark of manipulated-image authenticity/localization. Expert ratings are not a controlled test of whether explanations improve or degrade forensic decisions; no claim-level factuality adjudication, explanation faithfulness, inter-rater statistic, or causal reliance effect is established by the reported rubric. Mean scores and qualitative quotes should not be treated as calibration evidence.
screening_conclusion: Retain as strong adjacent human-evaluation evidence for forensic image-analysis narratives and overreliance concerns; distinguish it from image-manipulation detection and direct explanation-validity experiments.

paper: Comparative evaluation of lightweight CNN architectures for efficient and explainable deepfake detection
verified_identity: A. Bala Ayyappan; P. Thiyagarajan; Discover Computer Vision 1, article 3 (2026); version of record 2026-10-12; DOI 10.1007/s44584-026-00002-z; Springer Open Access.
relevance_class: Direct core: image-deepfake model explanation evaluated with deletion/insertion perturbation metrics.
scope_and_methods: Official Springer full text screened. Compares EfficientNet-B0, MobileNetV3-Small, ShuffleNetV2, SqueezeNet and ResNet-18 on OpenForensics: Wild. Alongside classifier and efficiency metrics, reports Deletion AUC, Insertion AUC and a combined XAI Score (Insertion AUC minus Deletion AUC). The paper interprets insertion as whether adding relevant regions raises model confidence and deletion as whether removing important regions lowers it.
observed_reliability_evidence: The work supplies a task-specific quantitative perturbation evaluation of visual explanations for image-deepfake detection. Reported XAI scores differ substantially across architectures; ShuffleNetV2 has the highest reported score (0.5168; Insertion AUC 0.7625), while other models show much lower or negative scores. This is evidence that the authors measured model-response sensitivity to selected regions, not an independent proof that maps identify causal/forged pixels.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Authors use one dataset and report a single experimental run without a stated random seed, standard deviations/confidence intervals, or significance tests. The reviewed paper reports no human assessment, independent manipulation-mask ground-truth alignment, parameter-randomization/sanity check, explanation stability across perturbation seeds/datasets, or causal intervention on a known forged region. Deletion/insertion scores are themselves sensitive to baseline/inpainting and masking choices; the reported score should be treated as one perturbation proxy rather than complete faithfulness validation.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a direct strong-relevance paper for image-forensics explanation reliability search. It directly evaluates deletion/insertion behavior, but its evidence does not establish comprehensive explanation reliability or human trust calibration.

paper: Seeing Through the Fake: Explainable AI With Multiple CNNs for Deepfake Detection
verified_identity: Muhammad Aleem et al.; IEEE Access 14 (2026), pp. 131–162; first published 2025-12-29; DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2025.3649128. Author-uploaded public full-text copy reviewed on ResearchGate; copy page displays CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. IEEE Xplore direct page separately returned HTTP 418 in this session.
relevance_class: 直接深伪图像/视频取证解释方法；解释质量主张较强但独立效度证据不足。
scope_and_methods: 全文核读。组合DenseNet201、Inception ResNet、XceptionNet、VGG16、ResNet特征提取器与五类传统分类器，在DFDC、Celeb-DF和FaceForensics++上做检测性能、预处理、模型配置和FGSM检测器鲁棒性实验；生成Grad-CAM与SHAP图。论文以解释方法应用前后分类“confidence scores”的变化声称量化XAI影响，例如DenseNet201+Random Forest由98.60%升至Grad-CAM后的99.10%，SHAP后最高99.47%。解释图用于展示面部区域，且只针对正确分类样本检查。
observed_reliability_evidence: 作者明确指出其XAI评价限于正确分类样本中是否关注语义相关面部区域；提供Grad-CAM/SHAP示例和所谓置信度对比。全文未给出独立篡改区域真值/专家区域标注对齐、删除插入/因果干预、参数随机化sanity check、定量解释稳定性或真人评估。将分类置信度变化称作解释质量并未提供清晰、可复核的操作定义，也不等于解释更忠实或使用者判断更可靠。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 论文在局限部分明确承认只在正确分类样本上做XAI分析，缺少正确与错误预测之间的系统性relevance-map失败案例比较。模型对抗扰动实验评估的是检测预测在FGSM下的鲁棒性，不能推作解释图鲁棒性。没有faithfulness、human evaluation或ground-truth解释匹配条目。XAI部分据语义可读性和置信度变化推论透明度/信任，缺少独立效度标准与参与者数据。
screening_conclusion: 保留为直接强相关方法论文，并列为解释信度主张与实证支持不匹配的例子。记录的解释展示和置信度变化是作者报告，不可引用为解释忠实性/人因可靠性已验证。

paper: DeFaX: A Cross-Attention Fusion Framework for Robust and Explainable Deepfake Detection
verified_identity: Md Al-Imran, Md Sifatullah Sheikh, Urmi Kirtonia, Nuzath Tabassum Arthi, Shamim Ripon; IEEE Access 13 (2025), pp. 213962–213979; DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2025.3645769. scope_and_methods: 全文核读。DeFaX以SwinEffAttn融合Swin Transformer全局表征与EfficientNet局部纹理，使用Grad-CAM和LIME展示人脸分类依据；主实验使用140K真实/伪造人脸数据，并报告准确率、AUC及跨数据集结果。作者对Dataset C正确样本与Dataset B误分类样本的LIME/激活图做定性比较：跨域误判样本上模型关注整个平滑人脸、较少聚焦局部伪造痕迹。

paper: Attention and residual mechanism-based CNN architecture (ARC-Net) with enhanced fairness generalization for deepfake facial image detection
verified_identity: Md Shihab Reza, Farhana Elias, Monirul Islam Mahmud, Nova Ahmed; PLOS ONE 21(4):e0340099 (2026); DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0340099.
relevance_class: 强相关：深伪图像分类的视觉解释定位量化评估；直接关联解释与人工区域的一致性，但非完整的因果忠实度评估。
scope_and_methods: ARC-Net以EfficientNetB0、残差与注意力模块进行真假人脸图像分类，展示Grad-CAM和LIME；另称在人工标注子集N=200（100 fake、100 real）上用VGG Image Annotator生成二值掩码，140/60划分后评估阈值化Grad-CAM区域与人工区域的一致性。作者报告IoU=.8396（95% CI .8071–.8684）、Dice=.9121（95% CI .8931–.9284）、88.9%测试样本的峰值激活落入标注ROI。
observed_reliability_evidence: 这是直接的空间定位/标注一致性指标，超过仅展示热图的定性论证；报告了IoU、Dice和峰值命中率。它支持“热图在该样本设置下与所用人工区域重叠”的有限结论。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 全文未明确人工标注区域表示实际deepfake篡改/伪造痕迹，还是一般面部/显著区域；也未清楚交代200张标注图与主分类器训练、验证和测试集合的对应/隔离方式，且称该子集用于train/test。标注者数量、专家资格、标注协议和一致性未充分报告；仅给聚合分数与代表性表格。IoU/Dice不检验模型对输入特征的因果依赖、参数随机化敏感性、删除/插入忠实度或用户适当依赖。全文其他位置的深伪分类/OOD/校准指标是检测可靠性，不等于解释可靠性。
screening_conclusion: 列为强相关的解释定位一致性实证案例，并在引用时明确其评价构念和协议报告不足；不可把作者的trustworthy/reliable表述扩展成已证明faithfulness。

paper: Interpretable-Aware Privacy Preserving Framework for Deepfake Detection using Federated ResNet and Explainable AI Techniques
verified_identity: Pochampally Chandra Sekhar Reddy; Kongara Srinivasa Rao; Research Square v1 preprint posted 2026-07-14, 17 pages; DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-10197752/v1. SSRN 7082140 is the same title/authors/abstract version, posted 2026-07-08.
relevance_class: 直接深伪图像检测与解释应用；主题相关，但没有解释可靠性效度评测；未同行评审。
scope_and_methods: FaceForensics++ deepfake classification with federated ResNet-18/FedProx. The proposed visual explanation combines an image-gradient edge map with a Gaussian-blur residual/noise map, then thresholds the combined map into a mask and overlay. Full text uses qualitative example figures to contrast real/fake visual patterns. Main quantitative results are classifier accuracy/precision/recall/F1.
observed_reliability_evidence: No independent explanation evaluation was found: no ground-truth manipulation masks or annotator protocol compared with explanation maps; no deletion/insertion or causal faithfulness test; no parameter randomization/sanity checks; no explanation stability analysis; no human evaluation or calibrated user reliance. Detection classification metrics do not validate the explanation.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Qualitative edge/residual visualization may expose handcrafted forensic cues but the paper does not establish that the displayed cues are the model’s decision-faithful evidence. The manuscript describes binary real/fake labels yet later discusses a seven-class confusion matrix and 150 samples per class, creating an internal task/reporting inconsistency. The item is an unreviewed preprint; trust/transparency claims are not experimentally tested.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a directly relevant explainable-deepfake application (tier 2), not as evidence that explanations are reliable. Count the SSRN record as a duplicate platform version, not a separate paper.

scope_and_methods: 官方摘要称提出MAFGTN-SA视频copy-move伪造检测器并使用LIME生成篡改区域saliency visualization；报告准确率/F1，不报告解释专属评测。

paper: A Hybrid Deep Learning and Forensic Approach for Robust Deepfake Detection
verified_identity: Sales Aribe Jr; International Journal of Advanced Computer Science and Applications, 16(10), 2025; DOI 10.14569/IJACSA.2025.0161028
relevance_class: 直接相关：深伪检测解释图—伪造区域掩码的定量空间对应；解释可靠性证据有限
scope_and_methods: 混合CNN/ViT与取证线索的人脸深伪视频检测。解释部分结合Grad-CAM与取证残差图；用FaceForensics++与Celeb-DF v2篡改掩码作参照。热图归一化后取最高20%激活区域，与mask计算IoU；IoU≥0.3定义为有意义对齐。作者报告500个正确分类假样本中410个达标（82%）。
observed_reliability_evidence: 报告了与篡改区域真值mask的空间重合率，属于局部化/接地一致性证据；不是单纯分类性能。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 仅正确分类fake子集；top-20%阈值与IoU≥0.3人为门槛，未报告阈值敏感性、连续IoU分布、按数据集/解释图类型拆分或不确定性；Grad-CAM与forensic map以‘either’合并，不清楚各自贡献。未见参数随机化/模型随机化sanity check、因果删除插入、解释扰动稳定性或人类信任校准/适当依赖实验。模型受压缩/对抗扰动时的分类鲁棒性不能替代解释图鲁棒性。正文也未给出用于该500样本mask分析的采样细节/可复现代码。

paper: An Interpretability Pipeline for Image Forgery Localization using GAN-Generated Forgeries and Grad-CAM
verified_identity: Samel M.; Mallikarjuna Reddy A.; Journal of Innovative Image Processing 7(2), pp.290–314 (2025); DOI 10.36548/jiip.2025.2.003; official full text.
relevance_class: 直接相关：图像伪造Grad-CAM解释与已知篡改mask的定量空间对齐评估
scope_and_methods: EfficientNetB1二分类器在CASIA v1训练/验证（文中称80/20）；DCGAN生成64×64 patch并固定插入224×224图像中心坐标(80,80)，由此获得已知mask。Grad-CAM层图以top-threshold后二值化并与mask比较；报告attention score、IoU、precision/recall/F1、SSIM、MSE。表1称100张伪造样本：attention=.8595±.0432、IoU=.0178±.0087、heatmap F1=.0321±.0143、SSIM=.1130±.0589、MSE=.1395±.0362。
observed_reliability_evidence: 直接把解释热图与已知篡改区域mask比较，且量化结果显示注意力分数高时IoU/F1仍极低；是解释空间定位不可靠的实证例，说明显著性/注意力强度不能代替边界正确性。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 论文摘要称IoU与pixelwise F1均为0，表1却报告非零近零值；摘要/正文措辞需以表值为准并保留冲突。定义A(H,M)=sum(H*M)/sum(H*(1-M))+eps，表中A=.8595，但按此公式<1表示mask内总热量低于mask外，与作者‘高注意力集中在伪造区’解释相冲突；文本还称‘average heatmap ratio’但公式为总和比。二值阈值t没有报告；表1是100样本，表2称50测试图，聚合口径不清。伪造patch固定在中心，存在位置捷径，作者也承认应随机化位置/形状。没有解释faithfulness输入干预、模型/标签随机化sanity、解释扰动稳定性或人类事实核验/适当依赖测试。故只支持对空间接地定位这一构念的有限、低质量评估，不代表因果faithfulness。
screening_conclusion: 强相关直接评估论文，纳入核心检索但标注显著内部报告矛盾与设计限制；其关键贡献是反例式证据：高显著性分数可能与极低mask overlap并存。

paper: Beyond Provenance: Evidence Attribution as a Framework for Synthetic Media Verification
verified_identity: Mahveen Raza; Syed Raza Bashir; OpenReview forum GRvJM7RnHb v2; NeurIPS 2026 Workshop RTCA accepted poster; published 2026-09-30
relevance_class: 强相关核心：合成媒体鉴伪中的证据归因正确性/证据支持性；跨视频/多模态，兼涉面部伪造
scope_and_methods: 概念框架区分来源归属、真实性判决与证据归属，并把可观测内容信号和外部上下文信号分开。实证探针在FakeAVCeleb每类抽取50段（共150段），用Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B零样本提示，最多取16帧；被判为伪造且正确识别后，将模型所引证据类别与该样本已知操纵类别比对。
observed_reliability_evidence: 表3中150段总体分类准确率41%，33/150伪造段正确检出；33段中27段（82%）至少报告一种与已知操纵相容的证据类别。FVRA视频-only象限为2/8；作者指出10条正确检出FVRA样本的证据引用中有7条提到唇同步不一致。该结果直接显示判决正确不能推出理由/证据归因正确。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 论文自称概念框架+初步探针。单一主模型、单一FakeAVCeleb、零样本单提示、贪心解码、至多16帧；Qwen2.5-Omni因检出的操纵样本过少未作有意义归因分析。归因只在正确检出的伪造样本上评估，FVRA有效n=8；兼容判据只要求至少一类证据与已知操纵相容，不验证具体声称的伪影是否可见，也不测删除/插入/参数随机化等因果faithfulness。生理信号、上下文证据未得到解释，context-level taxonomy未实证验证；未做人类适当依赖测试。
screening_conclusion: 高度相关、纳入强相关核心目录；作为证据归因正确性的早期直接实证/构念框架引用。不要把82%表述为总体解释准确率或faithfulness，也不要把自动分类准确与人类信任/依赖混为一谈。37条参考逐项主题筛查见T632。

paper: VidForensics-M1: Meta-Detection Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Temporal Grounding for AI-Generated Video Forensics
verified_identity: B. Liu, Z. Lu, Y. Bian, X. Zhang, X. Shui, Y. Huang et al.; arXiv:2608.11201v1, submitted 2026-08-11
relevance_class: 强相关核心扩展：AI生成视频取证中的证据有效性、时间接地与解释监督
scope_and_methods: 用真实视频片段移除并以边界帧条件生成新片段，构造配对真/假视频与可知伪造时间区间。生成45K开源和5K闭源视频假样本，组成100K平衡训练集；文本理由由GPT-5.5生成、Gemini-3.1-Pro筛选；Qwen3.5-9B/DAPO训练，Qwen3.5-4B作文本语义一致性评价；时间区间用IoU阈值0.7作为二值证据质量。
observed_reliability_evidence: 时间监督对照文本理由监督：ViF-Bench上Label-Tem-RL相对Label-Exp-RL提升准确率、召回率、F1分别6.25、6.38、6.96个百分点；GenBuster fake-only上OOD/Wild召回提升6.4/11.4。论文观察仅用文本监督时可描述一般伪造瑕疵却不能可靠定位操纵时间段；受控时间真值为可审计的证据有效性信号。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 任务是视频伪造时间定位，不是单帧图像/局部篡改解释；文本参照由GPT生成且Gemini过滤，文本一致性由Qwen辅助模型评价，仍有teacher/judge偏差和reward hacking可能；时间IoU仅验证时间段，不能验证文本理由中每一视觉主张的真实性；训练数据由受控片段重构生成，且仅假视频有证据奖励。未做人类解释适当依赖试验，不是因果faithfulness全面基准。
screening_conclusion: 纳入强相关核心扩展。可用于论证“解释文本相似”弱于可验证证据定位；引用时明确其视频时间证据任务和模型评模型边界。T635记录50条参考逐项题名主题筛查。

paper: DAVID-XR1: Detecting AI-Generated Videos with Explainable Reasoning
verified_identity: Yifeng Gao et al.; arXiv:2506.14827v1, submitted 2025-06-13
relevance_class: 强相关扩展：AI生成视频取证解释、人工线索精度与时空定位
scope_and_methods: DAVID-X含416个AI生成视频、337个真实视频；生成视频配缺陷类别、时间段、空间点和自然语言解释。DAVID-XR1用Gemini CoT蒸馏，基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B做CoT-aware SFT；测试集90段含新生成器和真实视频。解释precision定义为模型所报线索确实出现在视频且能有效指示AI生成；diversity是正确模型答复中识别出的GT证据覆盖比例。
observed_reliability_evidence: 正文§4.2称检测accuracy 76.7%、解释precision 62.5%；作者报告GPT-4.1虽有较高线索diversity，但大量线索为hallucinated/invalid，precision较低。这是“理由多≠理由可靠”的直接视觉视频取证证据。摘要/引言又称explanation precision 54.7%，与正文数字不一致；表3网页抽取格式也造成列值歧义，等待回到PDF原表复核。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 小规模自建数据与90视频测试；人工precision评审据称由DAVID-X labeler执行，未见独立双人盲评/一致性统计；CoT由Gemini在输入中看到GT标注后蒸馏，生成训练轨迹含教师模型影响。precision数值存在摘要/正文不一致；解释内容precision并不等同因果faithfulness、完整性或人类适当依赖。视频域，不直接代表静态图像。
screening_conclusion: 纳入强相关视频鉴伪解释目录；它实际测可见有效线索而非只报分类分数。对其解释precision数值暂不采用单一确定值，保留54.7%与62.5%冲突并待PDF表格复核。

paper: Learning Human-Perceived Fakeness in AI-Generated Videos via Multimodal LLMs
verified_identity: Xingyu Fu et al.; arXiv:2509.22646v1, submitted 2025-09-26
relevance_class: 强相关邻接：以人类视觉线索作为伪造痕迹的文本、框和时间监督
scope_and_methods: DeeptraceReward含3.3K高质量AI生成视频、4.3K详注和真实视频对照；每条人类/专家级标注包含文字解释、框选空间区域及时间起止。训练Video-LLaMA3-based 7B reward model模仿线索类别、定位和自然语言。
observed_reliability_evidence: 最佳7B model二分类准确率约99.4%，但细粒度任务仍明显较低：文本解释约70.6/100（LLM judge）、bbox IoU约32.6/100、时间距离约21.6/100。作者发现二分类优于迹象识别，迹象解释优于空间定位，空间定位优于时间定位；这说明分类正确不保证具体证据定位正确。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 研究主要为视频生成模型提供人类感知reward，不是司法取证/检测器解释系统；自然语言评分由LLM-as-a-judge按GT解释进行，可能受评审模型偏差影响；空间和时间基准各自也有限；作者明示标注需大量人力且可能有小错误。未直接评测人类用户是否依据模型解释作适当判断。
screening_conclusion: 纳入人类证据标注/解释接地邻接文献，引用时标清生成质量reward任务与取证解释可靠性的差异。

paper: Segmentation-Guided Spatial Indexing for Generalizable and Explainable Deepfake Detection
verified_identity: I. Al-Zyoud; A. E. Saddik; arXiv:2606.00098v1, 2026-05-25
relevance_class: 方法邻接：面部伪造检测的结构化区域归因机制
scope_and_methods: 冻结FaRL分割器将DINOv3面部patch映射到语义部位；在形成pooling descriptor之前，只保留目标区域patch，区域限定模型据此分类；在FF++训练、Celeb-DF v2与DFD跨域评测。

limitations_and_construct_boundary: 区域索引依赖FaRL自动分割且没有以独立真值篡改mask测定位误差；性能消融不能证明证据因果必要/充分，也没有语言理由事实核查、sanity check或人评；因此不是解释可靠性验证研究。
screening_conclusion: 保留为结构化可解释/区域归因方法邻接，不作为解释可靠性实证核心。

paper: OmniVerifier-M1: Multimodal Meta-Verifier with Explicit Structured Recalibration
verified_identity: Xinchen Zhang et al.; arXiv:2605.28805v1, 2026-05-27
relevance_class: 跨域方法邻接：一般视觉结果错误验证中的文本理由/符号定位反馈
scope_and_methods: 要求视觉验证器输出真伪判决及负例解释；比较Qwen语义一致性判分与bbox/keypoint IoU规则回报，并比较联合/解耦强化学习目标；在通用ViVerBench视觉结果验证任务评估。

screening_conclusion: 列为低优先方法邻接；可借鉴规则化空间真值，不纳入核心目录证据。

paper: A (Mid)journey Through Reality: Assessing Accuracy, Impostor Bias, and Automation Bias in Human Detection of AI-Generated Images
verified_identity: Casu, Guarnera, Zangara, Caponnetto & Battiato; Human Behavior and Emerging Technologies (2025), DOI 10.1155/hbe2/9977058; Wiley open access.
relevance_class: 人类对AI图像判真和自动化偏差的强邻接；不属于AI解释faithfulness核心
scope_and_methods: 746人、五个问卷版本；每版15幅图（真实、Midjourney、Midjourney+Magnific）；参与者先给真实性判定和简短说明，再查看ResNet-101概率建议并可改判；另比较人类反馈和Grad-CAM。
observed_reliability_evidence: 论文报告人类真实性识别准确率约47.0%–55.5%；展示算法建议后有显著意见改变，直接测自动化偏差。摘要报告人类整体判断与Grad-CAM局部关注存在差异。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 界面展示分类概率建议，不展示模型生成的文本/视觉解释；所以不能回答模型解释是否忠实或用户是否恰当依赖解释。样本是五套固定问卷和有限生成器/图像集；只作人因/依赖背景。
screening_conclusion: 保留为强人因邻接文献，单独标明其自动化偏差证据不能替代解释有效性或faithfulness测量。

paper: Evaluating Image Trust Labels in a News Recommender System
verified_identity: Forstner, Lysova, Starke & Trattner; INRA@RecSys 2025; CEUR Workshop Proceedings Vol-4056, short4.pdf.
relevance_class: 图像来源说明/用户信任与解释理解邻接；非模型鉴伪解释faithfulness核心
scope_and_methods: 官方全文N=202、四条件between-subjects实验，比较无标签、C2PA和两种Image Trust Score；记录新闻选择、图像/文章信任、标签解释是否被打开以及标签实际/自评理解。
observed_reliability_evidence: 标签条件提升文章信任但未显著改变图像信任或选择；44%将图像标签误认为文章信任，标签说明打开率仅2%–6%，呈现信任光环和自评理解与实际理解偏差。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 研究是新闻推荐中的来源标签/可信提示，不是鉴伪模型的生成解释；实验使用简化静态C2PA标签，参与者仅来自英美，不能直接外推模型解释faithfulness或法证决策效度。
screening_conclusion: 保留为解释信息呈现与信任校准的低优先邻接证据，严禁将标签信任变化当作模型解释有效性。

paper: FFAA: Multimodal Large Language Model based Explainable Open-World Face Forgery Analysis Assistant
verified_identity: Zhengchao Huang et al.; arXiv:2408.10072v2 (2024-11-21); official HTML.
relevance_class: 直接解释型人脸伪造分析系统；缺少独立解释可靠性验证。
scope_and_methods: OW-FFA-VQA task/benchmark; 95K-image Multi-attack source set and 20,142 GPT-4o-generated VQA pairs. Generated answers are filtered for format, correct authenticity/type, confidence >=0.6, then expert-approved; no expert count, allocation, blinding or agreement is stated in the inspected text. FFAA fine-tunes LLaVA-v1.6-Mistral-7B with hypothetical prompts and a Multi-answer Intelligent Decision System. Evaluation emphasizes accuracy, cross-dataset generalization and prompt robustness; qualitative MLLM comparisons and Grad-CAM visualizations are shown.
observed_reliability_evidence: Evidence-aware rationale generation and expert filtering of training answers; prompt-hypothesis perturbations are used to identify difficult samples and MIDS selects a consistent answer. These are training/robustness mechanisms, not an independent validation of each generated explanation.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The article does not report a human-subject evaluation of model-output explanation correctness or usefulness, claim-by-claim visual support, inter-rater agreement, causal input/feature intervention, deletion/insertion or parameter-randomization sanity checks, or appropriate-reliance calibration. Grad-CAM maps and qualitative examples do not establish explanation faithfulness. The MIDS match score and prompt robustness are not probability calibration. Expert approval is used during synthetic training-data filtering; reviewer counts and agreement are not reported. Scope is face forgery, not general image splicing.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a direct explainable face-forensics method and dataset paper, but not as empirical evidence that explanations are faithful or reliable. Full text reviewed; avoid treating the words “reliable reasoning” or “explainable” as validation results.

paper: SHIELD: An Evaluation Benchmark for Face Spoofing and Forgery Detection with Multimodal Large Language Models
verified_identity: Yichen Shi, Yuhao Gao, Yingxin Lai, Hongyang Wang, Jun Feng, Lei He, Jun Wan, Changsheng Chen, Zitong Yu & Xiaochun Cao; Visual Intelligence 3, article 9 (2025); DOI 10.1007/s44267-025-00079-w; version of record 2025-06-03; arXiv:2402.04178v2.
relevance_class: 强邻接：面部伪造检测与属性链式推理；包含文本解释自动代理指标，不是独立解释可靠性实证
scope_and_methods: SHIELD benchmarks MLLMs on face anti-spoofing and face forgery with true/false and multiple-choice prompts, zero/few-shot and CoT settings. MA-COT first describes selected shared/task-specific image attributes (e.g. texture, lighting, skin colour, facial features) and conditions the final real/fake judgment on those descriptions. The authors state the analysis is qualitative because explicit attribute labels are absent from test data. Main task metrics include ACC/HTER and, for SFT comparisons, AUC/AP/EER. Tables 27–28 also report BLEU-4, ROUGE-L and METEOR for generated text and discuss them as explanation-quality/interpretability indicators.
observed_reliability_evidence: There is an automatic text-overlap proxy for generated explanations, reported alongside detection performance; MA-COT supplies a structured reasoning prompt. These are relevant early evaluation signals, and the authors interpret metric gains as improved explanation quality/meaningfulness. They do not independently establish that text claims correspond to visible evidence or the model decision process.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The official v2 text reports no independent human audit of explanation factuality, no annotator agreement, no explicit attribute ground-truth comparison, no explanation deletion/insertion or counterfactual necessity/sufficiency test, no parameter-randomization sanity test, and no user appropriate-reliance study. The inspected article does not define an independently adjudicated evidence-grounded reference protocol for the BLEU/ROUGE/METEOR scores; lexical overlap can reward matching wording without proving visual truth. The authors themselves say MA-COT remains qualitative because explicit attribute labels are unavailable. Detector robustness and lower HTER are not explanation faithfulness.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a high-value adjacent benchmark and a documented example of evaluating generated forensic explanations with automatic text-overlap metrics. Do not count it as direct evidence that explanations are faithful, factually grounded, reliable under intervention, or improve human reliance.

paper: MAD-Sherlock: Multi-Agent Debate for Visual Misinformation Detection
verified_identity: Kumud Lakara, Georgia Channing, Christian Rupprecht, Juil Sock, Philip Torr, John Collomosse & Christian Schroeder de Witt; official arXiv:2410.20140v3, dated 2025-10-04 (first submitted 2024); the OpenReview title “Multi-Agent Debates for Out-of-Context Misinformation Detection” is a title/version alias.
relevance_class: 人类解释依赖与过度依赖方法邻接；OOC语境误配，不是数字图像篡改鉴伪
scope_and_methods: The system uses multi-agent LMM debate and external image/context retrieval to decide whether authentic, unaltered images are paired with misleading captions. The user study recruited 30 volunteers; each assessed 10 NewsCLIPpings image-text pairs (5 true, 5 misinformation), first unaided and then after seeing the system output, with confidence ratings. Participants were blocked from internet access. The studied explanations are multimodal/contextual rationales, not explanations of pixel-level forgery detector decisions.
observed_reliability_evidence: Human accuracy rose from 60.3±13.5 to 76.7±12.2 after system outputs; confidence generally increased. Crucially, the authors analyze two incorrect model outputs: six participants switched from correct to wrong on one false-negative case; in the false-positive case, 50% of all participants switched to the wrong verdict. Some initially wrong participants became more confident after seeing the output. This is direct evidence of both helpful reliance and overreliance under error, although on a different task.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Only 30 volunteers and 10 stimuli per person; the source reports no large-scale replication or inter-rater reliability. The task is context mismatch using unaltered photos, not digitally manipulated image detection. The study measures answer changes and confidence after system output, not causal faithfulness of a visual attribution, evidence localization accuracy, counterfactual necessity/sufficiency, or explanation stability. Therefore transfer to image-forensics decisions must be treated as methodological inference, not direct evidence.
screening_conclusion: Keep as a high-value adjacent human-reliance study and a useful design precedent for testing whether explanations help or mislead. Do not place in the direct image-manipulation/explanation-faithfulness core. Its 46 references were individually title/topic screened in T641; cited papers’ full texts are not implied reviewed.

paper: Inpainting the Gaps: A Novel Framework for Evaluating Explanation Methods in Vision Transformers
verified_identity: Lokesh Badisa and Sumohana S. Channappayya; arXiv:2406.11534v1, submitted 2024-06-17.
relevance_class: 解释方法测量学邻接；非图像取证研究
scope_and_methods: Proposes an inpainting-based perturbation protocol for evaluating ViT visual explanations while reducing distribution shift from naive masking; tests on ImageNet/PartImageNet settings and reports perturbation/consistency measures (including PC, SD, DC in the paper).
observed_reliability_evidence: Provides a concrete comparison framework for visual explanation behavior and cross-model consistency; relevant for selecting and interpreting perturbation-based reliability metrics.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: No image-forgery detector or manipulated-region ground truth is studied. Its metrics do not by themselves establish causal fidelity to a forensic classifier or human appropriate reliance. Treat as general XAI methodology, not domain evidence.
screening_conclusion: Include as a method-level neighbor for reliability evaluation design only; not a direct image-forensics paper.

paper: Multi-axis Analysis of Image Manipulation Localization (AUDITS)
verified_identity: Keanu Nichols, Divya Appapogu, Giscard Biamby, Dina Bashkirova, Anna Rohrbach & Bryan Plummer; arXiv:2605.20174v1 (2026-05-19).
relevance_class: 静态图像篡改定位/数据集与人类感知评估邻接；不是解释可靠性研究
scope_and_methods: AUDITS includes 530,640 image-mask pairs from COCO and VisualNews, with 11 diffusion-based replacement/removal/insertion methods. The study tests manipulation localization under image-source, manipulation-quality, manipulation-type and manipulation-size shifts. Its Amazon Mechanical Turk survey uses 4,950 images, each rated by three people (14,850 responses from 1,829 workers); questions concern perceived manipulation, object visibility, realism and naturalness.
observed_reliability_evidence: The authors analyze how human-perceived edit quality relates to image-manipulation detector performance and report source-domain and manipulation-type challenges. This supports task-level dataset and human-perception study design for forensic localization.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The human study rates edited image quality and detectability, not generated model explanations. It does not test explanation factuality, evidence attribution accuracy, causal faithfulness, perturbation sanity checks, explanation stability or human reliance on explanations. Semantic saliency means whether the edited object is mentioned in an image caption, not an attribution map. Findings are direct for manipulation detection/localization and only adjacent to explanation reliability.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a high-value task and perceptual-label benchmark neighbor; exclude from the direct explanation-reliability evidence core.

paper: Refining Visual Artifacts in Diffusion Models via Explainable AI-based Flaw Activation Maps
verified_identity: Seoyeon Lee, Gwangyeol Yu, Chaewon Kim & Jonghyuk Park; arXiv:2512.08774v1 (2025-12-09).
relevance_class: 生成图像伪迹区域解释的人类对照邻接；不是针对取证解释的验证研究
scope_and_methods: A real-versus-generated image classifier supplies CAM-based Flaw Activation Maps (FAMs) for detecting unrealistic regions in generated images; the maps guide diffusion refinement. In a human study, 15 participants selected the three most unnatural cells in tiled generated face images; the authors compared these to the FAM top-three activations.
observed_reliability_evidence: The reported average top-three cell match between human-selected and FAM-selected regions is 87%. This is a direct human-perception alignment test for a synthetic-image artifact map.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The map supports a generative image-refinement pipeline, not a forensic decision report. The study is small and reports overlap with subjective artifact regions; it does not establish causal faithfulness, parameter-randomization sanity, cross-dataset explanation stability, artifact localization against independently annotated manipulation masks, or appropriate user reliance.
screening_conclusion: Keep as a high-value adjacent human-region-alignment paper for synthetic-image explanation design; do not present as direct validated forensic explanation evidence.

paper: This Looks Distinctly Like That: Grounding Interpretable Recognition in Stiefel Geometry against Neural Collapse
verified_identity: Junhao Jia, Jiaqi Wang, Yunyou Liu, Haodong Jing, Yueyi Wu, Xian Wu & Yefeng Zheng; arXiv:2603.08374v1 (2026-03-09).
relevance_class: 通用视觉XAI的因果忠实性、稳定性和人评方法邻接；非图像鉴伪任务
scope_and_methods: Adaptive Manifold Prototypes reduce prototype collapse in intrinsically interpretable fine-grained image recognition. The paper evaluates on CUB-200-2011 and Stanford Cars and reports faithfulness/stability metrics. A human study with 50 participants scores Part Diversity, Evidence Sufficiency and Explanation Parsimony.
observed_reliability_evidence: The study combines causal-faithfulness/stability evaluation with human judgments of distinctness, sufficiency and parsimony, offering a relevant multi-construct evaluation design precedent.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The tasks are fine-grained object recognition rather than authentic-versus-manipulated image forensics. Human judgments of prototype explanations do not establish that a forensic localization map or natural-language evidence report is correct. Treat transfer as methodological guidance.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a methods neighbor for causal and human evaluation of visual explanations; exclude from direct image-forensics evidence.

paper: EditInspector: A Benchmark for Evaluation of Text-Guided Image Edits
verified_identity: Ron Yosef, Yonatan Bitton, Dani Lischinski & Moran Yanuka; ACL 2025, DOI 10.18653/v1/2025.acl-long.1428; arXiv:2506.09988v1.
relevance_class: 图像编辑差异说明的人工事实核验和幻觉评价邻接；非恶意篡改检测
scope_and_methods: The benchmark contains 783 MagicBrush edits with three crowd annotations per edit. Human annotations cover instruction accuracy, artifacts, technical precision, contextual consistency and difference captions. The paper reports annotator agreement and compares VLM edit judgments and generated difference descriptions against human annotations, including model precision and hallucination rate.
observed_reliability_evidence: Reported agreement averages 80–86%; majority agreement reaches 95% for edit accuracy and 97% for artifacts. Model-generated captions have low precision and high hallucination rates; the benchmark directly checks whether described differences correspond to human-annotated image changes.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The test images are instruction-guided edits, not malicious forgeries or authenticity decisions. Difference captions are a close grounding/factuality analogue for forensic reports but are not causal faithfulness evaluations of a detector explanation map. The benchmark does not measure appropriate reliance.
screening_conclusion: Keep as a high-value adjacent benchmark for human-grounded description factuality and hallucination in image manipulation; do not classify it as direct forensic explanation validation.

paper: Routing to the Right Expertise: A Trustworthy Judge for Instruction-based Image Editing
verified_identity: Chenxi Sun, Hongzhi Zhang, Qi Wang & Fuzheng Zhang; arXiv:2504.07424v1 (2025-04-10).
relevance_class: 指令编辑评价器的人类一致性和可解释判断邻接；不是图像鉴伪解释验证
scope_and_methods: JURE decomposes instruction-edit assessment into object, attribute, spatial, visual-integrity and related expert checks, then routes and synthesizes them into a scored natural-language judgment. From Emu Edit, the authors sampled 120 examples; nine annotators scored outputs from three editing models on a 1-5 Likert scale.
observed_reliability_evidence: Reported human-human Cohen kappa is approximately 0.45-0.78; general o1-human values are -0.22 to -0.12; JURE-o1-human is 0.54, within the human-human range.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: This is a judge-human agreement study for instruction-based editing success, not media authenticity or manipulation localization. The paper offers explanations by exposing routed experts and their feedback, but does not independently score whether the generated explanation faithfully reflects that evidence, nor test deletion/insertion, parameter-randomization or explanation stability. Human agreement should not be equated with explanation faithfulness.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a high-value evaluation-design neighbor for human baselines, inter-rater agreement and decomposed visual evidence; exclude from direct image-forgery explanation-validity evidence.

paper: On Attribution of Deepfakes
verified_identity: Baiwu Zhang, Jin Peng Zhou, Ilia Shumailov, Nicolas Papernot; arXiv:2008.09194v2 (2021-03-03; v1 submitted 2020-08-20).
relevance_class: 深伪来源归因＋视觉重建的人类可理解性邻接；不是图像伪造解释faithfulness实证
scope_and_methods: Assumes an image is already synthetic and attributes it to one of several candidate GANs by reconstructing candidate seeds, rendering candidate images, and comparing their visual distance to the target. In §6.6, 122 Mechanical Turk participants were recruited; 11 failing a placebo-round quality threshold were removed, leaving 111. Participants chose the most visually similar reconstruction among candidate-GAN rows. The dataset had 3,246 images and 5,710 votes; agreement was computed on 631 targets with at least three votes.
observed_reliability_evidence: Human attribution accuracy averaged 89.81% (SD 5.84%) versus 97.6% for the algorithm. Majority human and algorithm attribution agreed on 93.8% of the 631 targets (the contribution summary rounds this as 93.7%). This measures agreement in visual source attribution, not explanation truth or detector trust calibration.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The experiment presents reconstructed images as visual comparison evidence, not a natural-language rationale. It does not test causal explanation faithfulness, manipulation-region localization, evidence completeness, parameter randomization, deletion/insertion, explanation stability, or appropriate reliance. The paper explicitly leaves rigorous explainability analysis to future work. The 93.8% agreement must not be cited as an explanation-faithfulness score.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a high-value historical neighbor for human evaluation of visual attribution evidence and agreement; exclude from direct evidence that explanations are reliable or faithful.

paper: Visual Content Provenance and Change Summarisation
verified_identity: Alexander Black; University of Surrey PhD thesis, awarded 2024-12-20; DOI 10.15126/thesis.901401.
relevance_class: 强任务邻接：视觉内容溯源、篡改定位与自然语言变更摘要；非已证实的解释可靠性工作
scope_and_methods: The university repository abstract describes (1) scalable image provenance retrieval and manipulation-region localization/visualization, (2) video provenance and spatio-temporal manipulation localization, and (3) VIXEN/FVTC image-difference and sequential-edit textual summarization. METS includes human summaries of editing sequences. This assessment is limited to the official repository abstract; thesis chapters have not yet been reviewed.
observed_reliability_evidence: Abstract-level source confirms human edit-summary annotations in METS and reports that additional intermediate images/textual annotations improve captioning performance. It does not give explanation factuality, hallucination, agreement, faithfulness, or human-reliance results.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Do not equate change-captioning or provenance performance with explanation correctness. Need full-text review of dataset annotation protocol and VIXEN/FVTC metrics before deciding whether it informs factuality/evidence-grounding design.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a high-value task-method neighbor; mark abstract-only and do not count as direct explanation reliability evidence.

paper: GIFT: A Framework Towards Global Interpretable Faithful Textual Explanations of Vision Classifiers
verified_identity: Éloi Zablocki; Valentin Gerard; Amaia Cardiel; Eric Gaussier; Matthieu Cord; Eduardo Valle; arXiv:2411.15605v3 (2026-02-20; v1 2024-11).
relevance_class: 视觉分类器全局文本解释的因果faithfulness验证；图像鉴伪之外的方法邻接
scope_and_methods: GIFT generates local visual counterfactuals, converts changes to text, aggregates candidate global rules and checks hypotheses with interventions that add/remove the described concept. The paper reports DI pre-filtering and CaCE/PNS causal metrics; experiments cover CLEVR, CelebA and BDD-OIA. On CLEVR, hidden rules are recovered in 11 of 12 rule-architecture cases.
observed_reliability_evidence: Explanation hypotheses are screened by image-based interventions against the classifier. The paper identifies cases where high correlation does not imply causal impact and surfaces a planted left-lane bias on BDD-OIA. This is model-conditional causal faithfulness evidence, not evidence that a forensic explanation is factually true about image manipulation.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: No forensic authenticity/localization task and no own user-appropriate-reliance study. The authors state that image-editing failures can cause false negatives; verification assumes edited samples remain in-distribution and that other concepts stay relatively undisturbed; image-change captions and LLM summarization can introduce noise. Do not treat causal linkage to a classifier as proof the cited visual artifact is objectively forensic evidence.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a high-value methodological neighbor for intervention-based explanation-faithfulness design; not direct forensic evidence.

paper: On the Importance of Domain Awareness in Classifier Interpretations in Medical Imaging
verified_identity: David Major et al.; IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging 42(8), 2286–2298 (2023); DOI 10.1109/TMI.2023.3247659; PMID 37027636.
relevance_class: 反事实图像解释在分布外条件下的领域有效性；医学影像方法邻接，非图像取证
scope_and_methods: The official PubMed abstract says the work investigates whether heuristic counterfactual interpretations move pathology classifiers outside validated domains; it proposes marginalization techniques and evaluation procedures and demonstrates them on synthetic data, CBIS-DDSM/DDSM mammography and ChestX-ray14 radiographs.
observed_reliability_evidence: The abstract reports quantitative and qualitative reductions in localization ambiguity and clearer communication. It does not identify a human trust/reliance experiment or forensic classifier evaluation.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Abstract-level evidence only in this review. Medical image classification differs from manipulation/authenticity detection; reduced localization ambiguity is not equivalent to explanation faithfulness, factual grounding, or appropriate reliance.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a limited domain-shift/interpretation-validity methodological neighbor; do not count as direct forensic explanation reliability evidence.

paper: Towards Explainable Partial-AIGC Image Quality Assessment
relevance_class: 局部AI图像编辑质量与解释反馈的人类/机器评价；强任务邻接，非图像鉴伪可靠性
scope_and_methods: EPAIQA-15K has 15,026 edited-image samples with source image, edited image, prompt and edit-region coordinates; uses 12 editing tools. In the subjective study, 9,132 images each receive at least 10 independent participant ratings on overall editing quality, harmony, local naturalness and prompt completion. The model is trained in stages for region grounding, quality scores and explanation feedback. CoT rationales are generated by one proprietary LMM and accepted only when two other models agree they are reasonable.
observed_reliability_evidence: Human annotations provide a substantial baseline for edit quality and region grounding. Explanatory CoT is conditioned on human quality labels and cross-checked by two other models. There is no reported human rating of explanation correctness, evidence completeness, hallucination, causal faithfulness or reliance calibration.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Task is AI edit quality, not malicious tampering detection or authenticity judgment. Human scores validate perceived edit quality, not the generated explanation text. Cross-model agreement is not independent ground-truth verification and cannot be called explanation truth. Quality ratings also do not establish whether detector decisions causally depend on the grounded region.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a strong task-method neighbor for localized visual-edit grounding, multi-rater baselines and explanation-feedback protocol; do not count as direct forensic explanation reliability evidence.

paper: Hallucination at a Glance: Controlled Visual Edits and Fine-Grained Multimodal Learning
verified_identity: Tianyi Bai et al.; NeurIPS 2025 Main Conference; DOI 10.52202/085713-4517.
relevance_class: 微小图像变化感知与多模态幻觉；事实核验方法邻接，非取证解释
scope_and_methods: The official NeurIPS abstract describes MED, a controlled visual-edit dataset with 50K+ image-text pairs across 11 fine-grained edit categories and a balanced benchmark testing MLLM detection of small visual changes. Training targets stable visual embeddings and reduced hallucination.
observed_reliability_evidence: Reports improved visual-difference detection and reduced hallucinations against baselines including GPT-4o. The abstract does not report user evaluation or a detector explanation-faithfulness metric.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: This evaluates fine-grained visual understanding/change descriptions, not image authenticity detection or evidence-grounded explanations. Treat it only as a source of benchmark design ideas for checking whether a textual account captures an actual edit.
screening_conclusion: Retain as a lower-priority method neighbor for controlled edit-grounding/hallucination tests; not direct forensic reliability evidence.

paper: Region-based Saliency Explanations on the Recognition of Facial Genetic Syndromes
verified_identity: Ömer Sümer et al.; Machine Learning for Healthcare 2023, PMLR 219:712–736.
relevance_class: 跨领域视觉解释区域对齐/完整性方法邻接；非图像鉴伪
scope_and_methods: 提出适用于任意saliency方法的面部区域相关分数，并检查人类表型知识本体与DNN解释的对齐。官方摘要报告数据库含超过3,500张11类罕见面部综合征图像，另有171张由临床医生标注表型的测试图。
observed_reliability_evidence: 临床标注提供了外部语义参照；研究比较不同saliency解释与疾病表型/面部区域的一致性，并指出方法可能无法覆盖某人或某病的全部相关特征。可迁移为区域证据覆盖率和专家参照的一种验证设计。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 对象是临床遗传综合征识别，不是图像篡改或真实性鉴别；临床区域对齐不等于鉴伪判决的因果忠实性，也没有测量用户是否恰当依赖解释。当前只核对官方题录和摘要，未登记全文方法细读。
screening_conclusion: 保留为三级方法邻接；不得计入直接图像鉴伪解释可靠性实证。

paper: VDE Bench: Evaluating The Capability of Image Editing Models to Modify Visual Documents
verified_identity: Hongzhu Yi et al.; arXiv:2602.00122v3, 2026-06-11.
relevance_class: 文档图像编辑区域标注与人机指标一致性邻接；非鉴伪解释
scope_and_methods: 为密集中文/英文视觉文档编辑建立942项基准样本，包含文本和编辑区域标注；人工核验编辑样本，并以OCR文本级和图像级指标评价编辑模型。作者报告人工判断与自动指标高度一致。
observed_reliability_evidence: 人工核验和编辑区域标注可为局部图像操作的精确范围及自动指标的人类一致性比较提供设计参考。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 评价的是指令编辑模型是否完成修改，不是检测图像真伪，也没有产生或核验鉴伪解释；指标与人类对编辑质量的一致不能推作解释忠实性。作为邻接基准保留。
screening_conclusion: 保留为三级任务/评价方法邻接；不属于强相关鉴伪解释可靠性核心。

paper: Rethinking Visual Counterfactual Explanations Through Region Constraint
verified_identity: Bartlomiej Sobieski, Jakub Grzywaczewski, Bartłomiej Sadlej, Matthew Tivnan, Przemyslaw Biecek; ICLR 2025.
relevance_class: 受限区域视觉反事实解释与局部干预方法邻接；非取证
scope_and_methods: 官方摘要提出region-constrained visual counterfactual explanations，规定仅能修改预定义图像区域以改变分类器预测；使用条件inpainting的Region-Constrained Counterfactual Schrödinger Bridge生成反事实，并允许用户手动指定区域。
observed_reliability_evidence: 论文指出广泛、纠缠的图像修改阻碍明确解释，可能导致错误推理；区域约束使反事实与预设因素对应，因而可启发局部证据因果干预和解释所述区域的针对性审查。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 通用图像分类反事实方法，不是图像篡改鉴伪论文；其区域约束不自动证明某个鉴伪解释真实、充分或用户会恰当依赖。当前核对官方元数据和摘要，未登记完整论文实验细读。
screening_conclusion: 保留为二级方法邻接；引用时明确不是鉴伪解释可靠性的直接实证。

paper: The Impact of Neural Network Visualizations on User Decision Making in Deepfake Detection Using Heatmaps
verified_identity: Filip Brna; Brno University of Technology Master’s thesis 2025; thesis no. 164756; official English title in PDF
relevance_class: 直接人机使用/依赖研究：人脸deepfake分类器分数与Grad-CAM++热图对普通用户判别影响
scope_and_methods: 官方98页英文全文。LimeSurvey收集260份，清洗后204有效参与者，随机分Control n=70、detector-score n=67、score+Grad-CAM++ heatmap n=67。三组都看60张FaceForensics++人脸图（30真/30假，按两检测器置信度范围和错误情况选取）；参与者作真假二分类并报5点置信度。CWS因信心遗漏在167人上计算。检测器为EfficientNet-B3/B4。
observed_reliability_evidence: 整体F1组间未显著改善；人会随AI分数决策，且模型分数高时更跟随；模型错时score-only组准确率/CWS较控制组受损；score+热图组相对缓解错误建议造成的决策损害。作者也报告热图组较score-only组自陈AI依赖程度更高，但两组用户主观都认为热图不太有用。该研究提供使用后人类决策表现、信心和依赖证据，适合appropriate-reliance设计，不检验热图是否忠实反映真实鉴伪线索。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 不是heatmap faithfulness study：没有对每个热图与伪造区域/模型因果贡献独立对照。样本是普通网上参与者且人口构成偏年轻/男性/技术教育，在线实验预先告知主题，刺激集固定60张且面部deepfake范围窄。20%缺失信心被排除于CWS。VUT官方外审指出一些假设结论偏强/可能选择性解释、限制讨论浅、问卷与匿名原始数据未附影响复现、Likert应按序数、个别统计与定性分析报告不充分；因此将条件分层发现与overall null区别陈述，不按论文措辞上升为证明“解释可靠”。
screening_conclusion: 高相关human-AI reliance/appropriate reliance候选，目录rank 13.25。可说明heatmap可能改变错误AI建议下的用户表现与信心；不得用作解释内容真实性或causal faithfulness证据。

paper: What and Why? Towards Duo Explainable Fauxtography Detection Under Constrained Supervision
verified_identity: Ziyi Kou, Daniel (Yue) Zhang, Lanyu Shang, Dong Wang; IEEE Transactions on Big Data 9(1):133–146 (2023); DOI 10.1109/TBDATA.2021.3130165
relevance_class: 多模态图文错误信息解释的人评效用强邻接；非传统篡改/真实性取证解释忠实性
scope_and_methods: 任务把图文社媒post中的fauxtography定义为假图、假文本主张或两者关联错误。DExFC生成component-level content explanation并基于comments生成why explanation。论文用Twitter/Reddit数据做检测和内容解释量化评测；另用AMT对解释列表做真实用户研究：每条测试帖子把DExFC、dEFEND、HPA的Top-1/3/5评论列表呈给4名worker做list-wise偏好选择，平票时追加投票；再让worker从排序列表往下读并记录做出判断前读取数量，以评价阅读效率。
observed_reliability_evidence: 作者报告DExFC在两项指标上优于baseline，能提高用户偏好的评论解释列表并缩短决策前的读取成本。样本评论排序与用户偏好构成explanation usefulness evidence，不是每个理由的独立事实真值。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 图像只有fauxtography多模态帖子的一个组成部分，不是像素级图像篡改检测/定位模型；comment explanation根据注意力排序后由工人比较相对列表，没有独立专家逐条验证事实正确性/充分性、用户信任适当性或detector causal faithfulness。作者基于评论列表研究的效度不能外推至单张图像篡改解释。
screening_conclusion: 重要多模态错误图文解释人评邻接，作为边界明确的Tier-2候选；不计入直接image-forensics explanation reliability研究。

paper: Veritas: Generalizable Deepfake Detection via Pattern-Aware Reasoning
relevance_class: 强相关：深伪检测结构化推理解释与自动质量评价
scope_and_methods: HydraFake用于面部真/假图及分层OOD测试。Veritas输出fast judgement、planning、reasoning、self-reflection与conclusion结构化判决。MiPO训练使用3K偏好对，较优轨迹由人工专家标注。§5.4随机抽1K样本，由GPT-4o和Gemini-2.5-Pro按预设标准打分并做pairwise/ELO。
observed_reliability_evidence: 表7两种LLM裁判给Veritas+MiPO最高推理质量分4.6479/4.4214及ELO 1359；论文显式比较推理质量。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 测试期质量评价是两个MLLM-as-a-judge，不是独立人类评分；人工偏好用于训练而非held-out验证。没有在该评价中逐条核查视觉证据真值，也没有区域反事实/解释删除干预。因此结果支持两种LLM裁判下的理由质量相对比较，不能单独证明解释事实正确、因果faithfulness或改善适当依赖。任务限于面部深伪，向局部拼接/通用图像取证迁移需谨慎。
screening_conclusion: 强相关深伪解释质量评价先例；两条目录记录已统一为一个arXiv身份。

paper: A Unified Taxonomy for Investigating the Mechanisms of Multilingual Multimodal Misinformation
verified_identity: Nadav Borenstein, Greta Warren, Desmond Elliott, Isabelle Augenstein; arXiv:2608.29681v1 (2026-08-30)
relevance_class: 方法学邻接：多模态误导机制分类的人类一致性/正确性验证
scope_and_methods: §4.4两位作者专家为100个Community Notes样本应用误导taxonomy并报告IAA；§5.2对自动pipeline运行三次；§5.3比较VLM与人工标签并由两位作者判断630例机制标签是否正确。taxonomy含fake/manipulated image。
observed_reliability_evidence: mechanism/sub-mechanism人工一致率65.2%/56.8%；630例总体Cohen kappa=.67、raw agreement=82.3%；去除易判随机distractor后kappa=.44、agreement=80.3%；非distractor预测标签79.3%判正确，类别间差异明显。三次运行提供预测稳定性。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 对象是错误信息机制标签而非鉴伪解释。两个判定者均为作者，讨论后解决分歧；加入随机distractor抬高总体一致性。分类标签正确性不能替代自然语言解释真实性、区域接地、模型决策依赖或faithfulness评价。
screening_conclusion: 保留为图像误导标签的人类可靠性方法邻接；不计强相关解释核心。

paper: Is this real? Susceptibility to deepfakes in machines and humans
verified_identity: Didem Pehlivanoglu; Mengdi Zhu; Jialong Zhen; Aude A. Gagnon-Roberge; Rebecca K. Kern; Damon Woodard; Brian S. Cahill; Natalie C. Ebner; Cognitive Research: Principles and Implications 11(1), article 3 (2026-01-07); DOI 10.1186/s41235-025-00700-y; Springer Nature official open-access full text
relevance_class: 人机鉴伪与置信度的构念邻接；不属于XAI解释评价
scope_and_methods: 官方全文抽查摘要、研究目标、Study 1/2样本与任务、confidence结果和综合讨论。Study 1分析样本n=2,203，参与者判断静态人脸真实性；刺激池含FFHQ真脸和StyleGAN2生成脸。Study 2分析样本n=1,901，判断70条10秒视频，并含有声/静音条件；人类结果与CNN/视频模型对照。网页全文检索explanation、explainable、advice均无匹配。
observed_reliability_evidence: 直接测人机分类表现和置信度：图像任务中机器准确率高、人类近机会水平并对假脸显示truth bias与低信心；视频任务中人类优于机器。可用于解释研究中的人类基线、置信度与输入类型差异。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 未提供或评价模型解释，没有解释质量标注、解释忠实性干预、信任解释或appropriate reliance实验。故只能支撑相邻的人类鉴伪/置信度背景，不能作为解释可靠性的证据。
screening_conclusion: 纳入Tier 2人机行为邻接，保留并与直接解释评价文献分层；通过WEB-T636-SUPP-20261016发现，非Google Scholar分页结果。

paper: Effects of Browsing Conditions and Visual Alert Design on Human Susceptibility to Deepfakes
verified_identity: Emilie Josephs; Camilo Fosco; Aude Oliva; Journal of Online Trust and Safety 2(2), peer-reviewed (2024-02-28); DOI 10.54501/jots.v2i2.144
relevance_class: Tier 2 human-AI visual cue / reliance context; video deepfakes, not image-model explanation evaluation
scope_and_methods: 官方25页PDF范围核读摘要、Study 2 (pp. 5–6)、Results (pp. 10–13) 与 discussion/conclusion (pp. 14–16)。Study 2纳入298名参与者，比较text真假提示与Caricature伪迹增强；60条真/假视频、无时间压力。论文明确其提示标签不由模型实时预测，而按ground truth设置，因而“模型”在该环节为100%准确；测量最终信心、准确率、是否修改初判及修改幅度。全文检索“explanation”无命中。
observed_reliability_evidence: 伪迹放大使中等/困难视频的最终信心和正确率高于文字提示；参与者在Caricature条件更常改变初始答案，但改变幅度无显著差异。说明面向人的视觉证据提示设计可改变人机判断与信心；因反馈总正确，该结果不是错误模型下的校准/appropriate-reliance验证。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 对象为deepfake视频而非静态图像篡改定位；Caricature是基于伪迹放大的视觉信号，不是对检测模型实际依据的自然语言解释；研究辅助阶段的预测预设为真值，无法观察用户对错误AI建议的拒绝能力。未测解释内容的事实正确性、证据充分性、输入敏感性或因果faithfulness。
screening_conclusion: 保留Tier 2人因邻接，可用于解释“视觉提示提升信心/采纳”不等于解释可靠或错误情境下可适当依赖。明确排除于强相关模型解释可靠性核心计数。

paper: Towards Explainable Deep Learning with Attention Mechanisms for Fake Image Detection
verified_identity: Suen Kei Lau; Sook-Ling Chua; Lee Kien Foo; first published online 2025-03-11, ArtInHCI 2024 proceedings; DOI 10.3233/FAIA250106; official 7-page open-access paper
relevance_class: 直接解释型假图检测方法邻接；无解释可靠性验证
scope_and_methods: 全文核读摘要、方法、实验和结论。将CBAM并入ResNet18；真实脸来自FFHQ，假脸来自StyleGAN；训练10 epochs并作5-fold CV；比较完整人脸与眼/鼻/唇crop，报告accuracy/precision/recall/F1并展示CBAM attention maps。
observed_reliability_evidence: 没有独立解释真值、解释正确率、与真实伪迹区域的统计对齐、删除/插入、参数随机化或用户信任/依赖测试。文中指标主要评估分类器；attention权重可视化被解释为模型关注区域，但没有证明它忠实呈现决策依据。
