screening_conclusion: 纳入Tier 2直接任务方法邻接，可作“提出解释不等于评估解释”的对照。17条参考已逐项标题/主题筛查；其中[12]通用图像XAI指标研究为跨域方法邻接。

paper: Explainable Image-Centric Forgery Detection: A Survey
verified_identity: Xinyu Wu; Xiaohui Chen; Xintao Wu; Dong Li; Zhong Chen; Yi He; Chen Zhao; TechRxiv author preprint v1 posted 2025-10-21; DOI 10.36227/techrxiv.176101439.91738583/v1; corresponding SSRN abstract 5691366, cross-post/version identity not independently established
relevance_class: 强相关范围/解释评价综述；非实证验证
scope_and_methods: 24-page author manuscript, explicitly labelled preliminary and not peer reviewed. Organizes explainability into forgery localization, source attribution, and forgery judgment basis; summarizes about 40 methods and evaluation families, including pixel/region overlap, text-image consistency, LLM judging, human ratings, task utility, and cross-modal consistency.
observed_reliability_evidence: The review identifies that the field lacks a unified framework/standardized metrics for explanation quality, faithfulness, and consistency; practices remain largely qualitative and task-specific. It distinguishes semantic agreement and human preference from downstream utility but does not itself conduct a controlled explanation-validity experiment or meta-analysis.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Preprint is not peer reviewed. It synthesizes selected recent methods and cites evaluation descriptions; its taxonomy and assessment of the literature are not an independent validation dataset. Do not conflate detection robustness, localization overlap, LLM judges, human preference, and causal faithfulness.
screening_conclusion: High-priority scope review and source for gap framing; include as a survey/preprint, not as empirical proof that any method is reliable. TechRxiv full text retrieved despite direct SSRN 403.

paper: Attention Map-Guided Visual Explanations for Deep Neural Networks
verified_identity: Junkang An; Inwhee Joe; Applied Sciences 12(8), 3846 (2022); DOI 10.3390/app12083846; official MDPI full article
relevance_class: 跨域方法学邻接：通用图像saliency量化；不是图像取证研究
scope_and_methods: 以Grad-CAM生成的特征图接注意力模块形成视觉解释；在ImageNet上的VGG19/ResNet-50/GoogLeNet等分类模型比较Grad-CAM、Grad-CAM++、SmoothGrad-CAM++、XGrad-CAM；报告average drop、percent increase和percentage-in metric。
observed_reliability_evidence: 提供依赖模型分类分数与top-x%掩膜/区域的模型侧代理指标；没有在伪造图像取证上验证，也没有独立伪迹真值、人类判断或AI建议正确/错误条件下的依赖校准。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: average-drop/percent-increase评估分类分数变化或定位，不等于因果完整faithfulness，更不证明图像鉴伪解释中的事实正确性。其自身结论承认attention可能突出spurious regions。
screening_conclusion: 纳入Tier 4方法学背景，用于解释为什么attention-map或模型分数proxy不能单独证明法证解释可靠。

paper: Deployable image forgery detection and localization: A comprehensive review and practitioner’s guide
verified_identity: Maryam Munawar; Mourad Oussalah; Expert Systems with Applications 311 (2026), 131347; DOI 10.1016/j.eswa.2026.131347; official OuluREPO open-access author/publisher copy
relevance_class: Tier 2 scope/context review: image-forgery explainability and evidentiary utility gap; non-empirical for explanation validity
scope_and_methods: Reviewed selected full-text sections of the 29-page review: search strategy/quality appraisal (§3.1), taxonomy, explainability-and-trust gap discussion, and future directions. Scope is image forgery detection/localization literature 2016–2025. Authors report 588 records identified, 396 after deduplication, 148 after abstract screening, and 120 retained after full-text review; two reviewers screened, but the article says it is PRISMA-style rather than fully preregistered systematic review.
observed_reliability_evidence: The review explicitly names explainability and evidentiary utility among persistent challenges and states that deep models often lack human-interpretable rationale; it identifies the area as nascent and calls for evidence-bearing methods. Its quality appraisal axes (internal, external, construct, conclusion validity) help frame the review protocol. It does not measure explanation factuality/faithfulness itself.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: Broad detection/localization survey, not an XAI validation review or meta-analysis; review period ends at 2025 despite 2026 publication. Does not define or test a causal-faithfulness benchmark, human explanation-label reliability, explanation stability, or appropriate reliance. Do not use its detection accuracy and robustness studies as explanation-validity evidence.
screening_conclusion: Useful English-language scope and gap reference for establishing that image-forensics explainability/evidentiary utility remains an open topic as of 2026. Include as Tier 2 background, not as a strong empirical explanation-reliability paper.

paper: FakeBench: Probing Explainable Fake Image Detection via Large Multimodal Models
verified_identity: Yixuan Li, Xuelin Liu, Xiaoyang Wang, Bu Sung Lee, Shiqi Wang, Anderson Rocha, Weisi Lin; arXiv:2404.13306v2 (2024); IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security, 2025; DOI 10.1109/TIFS.2025.3597211
relevance_class: 直接核心：AI生成图像鉴伪中的自然语言证据解释与解释质量代理评价
scope_and_methods: FakeBench含FakeClass（6,000张图的真假分类）、FakeClue（3,000张伪造图的线索说明）及FakeQA（42,000组开放问答）。伪迹描述由GPT-4V辅助生成，再由人工专家核验/补充；专家只修订自己首先判断正确的图像。另有34名参与者对200张真图和200张假图做真实性判断与线索选择，用于验证线索分类体系。
observed_reliability_evidence: 开放式解释以BLEU、ROUGE-L、句向量相似度及GPT-4 judge评分，GPT judge分别评完整性、精确性（与golden clues冲突会扣分）和相关性；每条回复重复评分5次取平均。官方正文同时报告解释/推理和鉴伪判断并不稳定耦合，CoT使多数模型检测表现下降。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 34人实验评估的是人类辨别能力和伪迹分类体系，并非人类对模型生成解释逐条判真伪。模型解释评价主要依赖文本相似度和同一GPT-4评审器，重复5轮仅反映重复评分均值，不构成评审器间一致性或独立金标准。未见解释输入扰动、参数随机化、删除/插入因果忠实性，亦无用户适当依赖实验。专家gold clues只针对专家本人判对的图像精炼，需留意选择条件。
screening_conclusion: 强相关基准；可作为“人工线索参照 + 自动/LLM解释评分”的直接证据，但评分效度有限，不能标成解释faithfulness金标准或模型解释的人评证据。该条与TriDF参考[72]的旧题名为同一arXiv:2404.13306，复用N0531，不重复计篇。

paper: Forensics-Bench: A Comprehensive Forgery Detection Benchmark Suite for Large Vision Language Models
verified_identity: Jin Wang; Chenghui Lv; Xian Li; Shichao Dong; Huadong Li; Kelu Yao; Chao Li; Wenqi Shao; Ping Luo; CVPR 2025, pp. 4233–4245; DOI 10.1109/CVPR52734.2025.00400; arXiv:2503.15024v2.
relevance_class: 邻接：多模态伪造检测/定位基准与检测判决稳健性；非解释可靠性直接研究
scope_and_methods: Forensics-Bench包含63,292个多选视觉问答，覆盖112类伪造类型；评估22个开源及3个专有LVLM，任务含二分类、空间定位、时间定位。§3.3对输入施加饱和度/对比度变化、区块失真、模糊、噪声和JPEG压缩以测伪造检测能力稳定性；“forgery attribution”将样本改为识别所用AI生成/操纵模型。
observed_reliability_evidence: 可支持取证检测能力的跨任务/类型差异与输入扰动下检测表现分析；作者指出空间定位比二分类提供更多可解释信息，并称来源模型识别为答案提供解释性支持。§4.1及附录§11报告的主要评价指标为accuracy。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 扰动协议测的是检测判决稳定性，不是解释热图或自然语言解释的稳定性；来源模型归因不是XAI特征归因。作者稿没有独立解释质量/事实性/证据接地/faithfulness指标、逐条人工解释审查或用户适当依赖实验。多选问答中的reasoning能力不等同于自然语言解释可靠性。

paper: Cultivating Forensic Reasoning for Generalizable Multimodal Manipulation Detection
verified_identity: Yuchen Zhang et al.; ACL 2026 Long Papers, 2026.acl-long.1316, pp.28545–28560; DOI 10.18653/v1/2026.acl-long.1316; arXiv:2603.01993v1 preprint title: Process Over Outcome: Cultivating Forensic Reasoning for Generalizable Multimodal Manipulation Detection
relevance_class: 直接强相关核心：多模态图像/文本操纵取证理由的接地审计（tier 1）
scope_and_methods: Peer-reviewed ACL final paper introduces REFORM and ROM for multimodal image/text manipulation detection, rationale generation, answer alignment, and consistency-oriented training. In §4.3, the authors report a blinded human audit of 350 ROM samples for distilled teacher rationales. The arXiv v1 preprint has an additional Appendix F.2 study: 18 volunteers assess 193 sampled model-generated reasoning cases on a four-point convincingness/trust scale. The preprint-only study is not present in the final ACL paper and is recorded separately.
observed_reliability_evidence: Final ACL Table 6a reports recovery of 83.7% of ground-truth visual evidence and 82.2% of ground-truth textual evidence in the blinded audit of teacher rationales. The arXiv v1 appendix reports 85.8% acceptable/highly convincing ratings on average and 5.5% not-convincing ratings for the sampled generated reasoning. These are evidence-recall and perceived convincingness outcomes, respectively; they are not interchangeable.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The ACL paper does not report the number or qualifications of auditors, the evidence-recall rubric, inter-rater agreement, uncertainty intervals, or enough detail to establish that the audited teacher rationales are the final REFORM outputs. The preprint-only trust/convincingness study has 18 volunteers and 193 sampled outputs; it measures perceived persuasiveness, not appropriate reliance under correct/incorrect model decisions. Neither version establishes causal faithfulness via interventions, evidence necessity/sufficiency, stability under benign changes, or calibrated user reliance. The ACL authors also state that rationale quality is not explicitly optimized.
screening_conclusion: Promote N0009 from abstract-level tier 2 to a directly relevant tier 1 core candidate because the final paper contains a blinded human evidence-recall audit. Cite the final peer-reviewed metrics with their teacher-rationale scope and reporting gaps. Cite the 18-volunteer convincingness result only as arXiv v1 preprint evidence; do not attribute it to the ACL final version or call it appropriate-reliance validation.

paper: TRUST-VL: An Explainable News Assistant for General Multimodal Misinformation Detection
verified_identity: Zehong Yan, Peng Qi, Wynne Hsu, and Mong-Li Lee; EMNLP 2025, 2025.emnlp-main.284, pp.5588–5604; DOI 10.18653/v1/2025.emnlp-main.284; arXiv:2509.04448 HTML v2
relevance_class: 邻接：带结构化理由的多模态虚假信息检测，含视觉操纵子任务
scope_and_methods: TRUST-VL generates structured reasoning for textual, visual, and cross-modal misinformation, including DGM4-Face face manipulation, MMFakeBench edited/AI-generated images, and Fakeddit-M digital edits. The authors manually inspect a subset of generated TRUST-Instruct items for coherence, distortion-type alignment, reasoning-step order, specialized-step correctness, and final-label agreement; they report 98.5% pass and filter the remainder. Main model evaluation reports accuracy and macro-F1 across datasets.
observed_reliability_evidence: The 98.5% figure is a manual quality-control result for a subset of synthetic training instructions/reasoning chains. It supports dataset curation quality, not the validity of model-generated explanations at inference. No direct explanation-evaluation metric or user study is reported in the reviewed full text.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The manually inspected subset size, auditor qualifications, rubric calibration, and inter-rater agreement are not specified in the reviewed text. Accuracy/macro-F1 and ablations show detection-task performance, not explanation factuality, evidence grounding correctness, causal faithfulness, stability, or appropriate reliance. The work is broader multimodal misinformation detection rather than a dedicated image-forgery explanation reliability study.
screening_conclusion: Keep N0925 as an adjacent task/system reference, not as direct empirical evidence that explanations are reliable. Its manual instruction filter is distinct from human evaluation of final model explanations.

paper: Seeing Through the Blur: Unlocking Defocus Maps for Deepfake Detection
relevance_class: 直接强相关：图像/视频深伪检测中的SHAP解释与已知物理伪影线索对齐评估
scope_and_methods: 提出defocus-only深伪检测与RGB+defocus合成图检测。用gradient-SHAP分析模型归因；每类抽取1000个测试样本，用真实/合成defocus差异分布作为线索参照，计算归因分布与差异分布的overlap alignment score及KL divergence。
observed_reliability_evidence: 提供定量的线索一致性证据：作者报告SHAP聚焦于defocus差异区域，并用较高重叠/较低KL支持模型使用目标物理线索。此类证据较题名/热图展示更强，直接相关于取证解释的可验证性。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 对齐指标比较SHAP分布与作者构造的defocus差异统计，不等同于像素级真实篡改掩码的解释正确率；没有parameter randomization、deletion/insertion或反事实干预等因果faithfulness sanity checks，也未做解释事实性人工审查、解释完整性或用户适当依赖实验。SHAP方法/实现的其他敏感性仍需评估。
screening_conclusion: 纳入强相关文献：作为physically grounded explanation alignment的量化先例。应限定为已知线索一致性，不泛化为已证明因果faithfulness或人类效用。

paper: MM-VeriAgent: Learning to Use Extensive Tools to Verify Multimodal Misinformation with Reinforcement Learning
verified_identity: Peipei Li; Shuhan Xia; Shengyang Liu; Zekun Li; Ran He; arXiv:2609.30698v1, 2026-09-25
relevance_class: 方法邻接：多模态取证核验中的证据接地奖励；不是解释可靠性直接测量
scope_and_methods: 图文真假核验，来源类别含visual veracity distortion（含AI生成/操纵图像），模型调用视觉取证、操纵定位和跨模态工具，输出结论、来源类别、证据集合及自然语言reasoning。GRPO奖励包括预测证据与参考证据集合Jaccard重叠，且仅在来源分类正确时计分。

screening_conclusion: 保留为证据接地/训练奖励方法邻接，不计入直接解释可靠性实证文献数量。

paper: Explanation-Driven Counterfactual Testing for Faithfulness in Vision-Language Model Explanations (EDCT)
verified_identity: Sihao Ding, Santosh Vasa, Aditi Ramadwar; arXiv:2510.00047v1, 2025-09-27
relevance_class: 最强方法邻接；通用VLM解释反事实忠实性测试，非鉴伪任务
scope_and_methods: 获取目标VLM答案和自然语言解释，抽取解释所称视觉概念，针对概念生成局部反事实编辑，再用LLM辅助评分检查答案与新解释是否服从编辑后视觉证据；报告PCS/NCC/CCS。实验为120个OK-VQA图像问题和多种VLM。
observed_reliability_evidence: 直接将模型自己的解释转成可证伪视觉概念，并通过定向图像改变检验后续回答/解释是否协调；为本研究提供最近的方法模板。
limitations_and_construct_boundary: 通用VQA而非取证鉴伪；单样本仅一个反事实，编辑现实性、概念抽取及LLM judge都会影响分数；没有鉴伪标注者验证或真实伪迹移除。
screening_conclusion: 强方法先例，不能当作图像鉴伪解释可靠性已有基准的证据。
